description:
The Role

We are looking for a Junior Automation Engineer to grow into the technical care of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) behind our fab - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. Here's the best part: you'll join during the final commissioning phase, working side by side with the specialists who bring the system to life. You'll learn it hands-on while the people who built it are still on site - and grow, step by step, into independent ownership. It's about as good a launchpad for a career in automation engineering as you'll find.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Support the operation, monitoring and maintenance of our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA) and our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs

  • Take part in loop checks - learning to trace each signal from the field device through I/O and PLC to the operator screen, and to confirm that commands move valves, dampers and actuators; one of the fastest ways to understand the whole system

  • Help investigate and resolve alarms and faults during commissioning and live operation

  • Support instrument calibration checks and field-signal troubleshooting

  • Help build datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and keep documentation up to date

  • Gradually take on more system responsibility as your confidence grows

  • Work closely with experienced colleagues and with our facility and IT teams

Your Qualifications

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

Why Conduct

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change and every new product line runs into SAP systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

The mandate is broad: you'll work across external, customer, partner, talent, and internal communications, and help shape the strategy behind all of them.

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

description:
About the Team

Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but operational in how we execute, and we support every product and research effort at OpenAI. InfraSec safeguards the core of OpenAI’s research and production environments—GPU supercomputing clusters, multi-cloud infrastructure, datacenters, networking, storage, and the critical services that power our frontier AI models. Our charter spans everything from bare-metal hardware and firmware to Kubernetes clusters, service meshes, and the data pathways that carry highly sensitive model weights and user data.

As a Security Software Engineer, you will design and build critical foundational services, such as authentication systems, egress/ingress proxies, access brokers, and key management platforms, that demand high standards of reliability, scalability, and software craftsmanship. These systems form the security backbone of OpenAI’s supercomputing environment and must remain robust under intense scale and adversarial pressure.

  • Partner with infrastructure and research engineers to embed security into high-performance compute clusters, enabling rapid model training and deployment without compromising protection.

  • Develop automation and detection tooling to continuously identify and mitigate risks in large-scale cloud and on-prem environments.

  • Drive high-impact initiatives such as line-speed encryption, machine identity, and network isolation, continuously raising the security bar for emerging AI workloads.

  • Lead or participate in design reviews and threat models to ensure new systems launch with strong security foundations and operational excellence.

  • Strong software engineering skills in languages such as Python, Go, Rust, or C/C++, with a track record of shipping and operating high-reliability distributed services.

  • Experience building or operating critical security infrastruct

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

title: VA (Virtuelle Assistenz) Social Media & Content Manager (w/m/d) - Freelance, 100% Remote
description:

title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it.

It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.

For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.

The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most

Lumai is moving from breakthrough optical-compute research to production AI systems. We need an engineer to build the performance and power modelling capability that guides architecture and compiler decisions before silicon exists, helping us turn a working system into a competitive product.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai’s photonic AI hardware will perform against real inference workloads. Your models will give architecture and compiler teams a shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across hardware configurations.

The hard part is balancing speed, fidelity and usability: you will model concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency at enough detail to support decisions, while keeping simulations fast enough to compare configurations in minutes. You will characterise operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results so the model stays grounded in evidence.

By month six, you will have established a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, demonstrated a clear path for closing gaps between model and hardware, and made the simulator a tool that architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions. You will report to the Head of Architecture or VP Engineering and may build and lead a small team around this capability.

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

title: Enhetschef Kundenhet Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna
description: Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna ansvarar för drift av hjälpmedelsverksamhet för personer med rörelsehinder i södra delen av Stockholms län samt länsövergripande ansvar för personer med behov av förbrukningshjälpmedel i hemmet,  medicinteknisk apparatur i hemmet samt kommunikations-, kognitions-, syn- och hörselhjälpmedel. title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.  Role Purpose  As our Customer Success Manager, you'll make sure customers keep getting real value from Next, our project management and financial control platform for construction companies. Next gives project managers and site teams visibility into project economics, budgets, costs, revenue and progress, both on individual projects and across the business. You'll do that by keeping a close eye on customer health, engagement and usage, and catching risks and opportunities early. This is a role for someone who wants to help build how Customer Success works, not just fit into it. Building the function is something the whole team owns together, and we're looking for someone who gets a real charge out of that. Someone who's comfortable when the path is a bit foggy and can bring structure to the mess. We think one-to-many. The goal isn't just solving things for one customer at a time, it's finding ways to make things better for several customers at once. We'd rather build something that scales than lean on one-off 1:1 meetings. title: Enhetschef till Avfall
description: Om arbetsplatsen   Vi är en viktig samhällsbyggare som levererar effektiva och hållbara vatten- och avfallstjänster – för dagens och framtida stockholmare. Varje dag, året runt, förser vi 1,6 miljoner stockholmare med rent och gott kranvatten, renar avloppsvatten och ser till att avfallet tas om hand. Tillsammans med invånare, företag och andra intressenter arbetar vi för att Stockholm ska bli världens mest hållbara stad.   Arbetsuppgifter   Avfallsverksamheten i Stockholm har en miljon kunder och en verksamhet som engagerar. Uppdraget innebär att hantera det kommunala ansvaret för avfallshantering i en offentligt styrd verksamhet. Vi söker nu en engagerad och operativ enhetschef till enheten Samordning. Enheten har ett brett uppdrag med fokus på kundnära frågor vilket bland annat omfattar rådgivning till kund om avfallslösningar, information och dialog om avfallshantering, implementering av lagförändringar och insamlingssystem samt utredning och hantering av kundärenden. Inom enhetens uppdrag återfinns även drift och underhåll av stadens 250 återvinningsstationer.  Här får du möjlighet att tillsammans med 13 medarbetare utveckla arbetssätt och processer i syfte att skapa effektiva lösningar för kunder och utveckla vårt kundbemötande. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på huvudkontoret i Ulvsunda, Bromma.  Inom enhetens uppdrag ligger bland annat:     Rådgivning om avfallslösningar   Informations- och kommunikationsinsatser om avfallshantering   Samordning och fördelning av kundärenden   Samordning och implementering av nya lagkrav och ansvar   Utredning och hantering av kundärenden och kundbestridanden   Drift, underhåll och skötsel av återvinningsstationer samt att säkerställa erforderliga tillstånd kopplat till dessa   Upphandlingar, avtalsförvaltning och entreprenörsrelationer   Uppdrag inom avfallsförvaltningen enligt delegation     Kvalifikationer   Vi söker dig som är kund- och resultatorienterad, med förmåga att omvandla analyser till konkreta förbättringar i metoder och arbetssätt. Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och god förmåga att leda, samordna och implementera utveckling. Som person är du kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta i team där du bidrar med engagemang och en positiv laganda. Det är av betydelse att du är samarbetsinriktad eftersom rollen innebär utveckling och implementering av processer och arbetssätt som får påverkan för fler enheter.  För att lyckas i tjänsten tror vi att du har:     Högskoleutbildning inom för uppdraget relevant område eller erfarenhet som bedöms likvärdigt   Flerårig erfarenhet som chef/ledare med budget-, personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar samt erfarenhet av att styra och leda konsulter   Förmåga att se helhetsbild, erfarenhet av att driva förändringsarbete och att prioritera insatser   Flerårig erfarenhet av processer kopplat till kundnära frågor och kunddialog   Mycket god samarbetsförmåga samt förmåga att etablera och bibehålla kontakter och samarbeten internt och externt   Mycket

Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Insurance Team ⭐️

Being part of Alan's insurance community is a great opportunity to have a significant impact on people's health and wellbeing in our multiple countries of operation.

title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in France.

You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference.
Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.


Accountabilities
  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation

title: Senior Security Assurance Specialist
description:
Location: Office First - Berlin

Team description

Our security assurance team keeps SumUp's information security programme credible, both to regulators and to the millions of merchants who trust us with their business. As part of a small global team spanning Europe, Brazil and Chile, you'll help translate frameworks like ISO 27001, PCI DSS and NIST into practical controls that hold up under real audits and real third-party scrutiny. This is a chance to shape how a fast-growing fintech proves its security maturity across multiple regulatory environments at once, with real ownership over the areas you improve.

What you'll do

  • Review information security controls, audit findings and risk mitigation plans, working with other teams to put the right fixes in place
  • Run third-party due diligence, supplier reviews and contract assessments as part of the third-party risk management process
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to promote strong security practices and help embed security principles into their day-to-day processes
  • Support external and internal audits and due diligence requests, responding directly to auditors, clients and partners
  • Track relevant laws, regulations and security standards, flagging gaps against SumUp's existing controls
  • Help maintain and improve the team's security maturity picture, identifying priority areas and leading or supporting initiatives to close them

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Experience reviewing and improving information security controls in a similar assurance or GRC-focused role
  • Strong knowledge of information security standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST, plus payment security standards like PCI DSS
  • Comfort working with third party risk management and audit procedures, including supplier and contract reviews
  • Ability to prioritise and simplify complex, sometimes ambiguous request

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Team description

The Central Product Analytics team sits at the heart of how SumUp understands and improves the experience of millions of merchants using our products every day. This role owns the Engagement domain — covering merchant engagement, product activation, support responses, and navigation across the SuperApp and web dashboard — and is the primary analytics partner for the Engagement product team. It's a genuine opportunity to take full ownership of a domain, build the measurement foundations from the ground up, and shift the team from reactive reporting to proactive, insight-led decision-making.

What you'll do

  • Define event taxonomies and measurement plans, implement and QA tracking (GA4), and make sure analytics is built into new product features from day one

  • Build and maintain scalable datasets in Snowflake — including funnels, customer behaviour models, and feature adoption metrics — and use them to generate insights that directly inform product decisions

  • Design and evaluate A/B tests: define success metrics, assess statistical validity, and communicate results clearly to product and engineering stakeholders

  • Create and maintain intuitive dashboards and reusable query templates in Tableau that help teams answer their own questions without always needing an analyst

  • Partner with product managers to develop and map out KPI trees, identify measurement gaps, and improve the quality and accuracy of engagement tracking across the domain

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Proven experience as a Data or Product Analyst, with a strong track record of working with customer behaviour data and translating it into product decisions.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including writing, optimising, and validating queries, building data models, and participating in code reviews.

Pysae est un éditeur de logiciels de 40 personnes qui développe des solutions SaaS pour le secteur du transport public. Nous connaissons une forte croissance, portée par un marché en pleine transformation numérique.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

title: Head of Product Management
description:
So why should you read on?

Are you passionate about leveraging newest technology to create meaningful change? Do you thrive in a leadership role where you can empower and inspire Product Managers to reach their full potential? If you're ready to take ownership and drive real impact, we want to hear from you.


You're the one we are looking for, if

As Head of Product Management, you are a Shaper, Challenger, and Mentor with high emotional intelligence. You evolve the product team's strategy and work closely with other leaders on overall company strategy. You drive team upskilling, foster process synergies across accounts, and integrate deep technical and AI expertise into everyday work. title: Global Director of VIP
description: Global Director of VIP | iGaming (Crypto-Native)   Own the VIP program end to end at one of the fastest-moving crypto-native iGaming operators in the market.     This isn't a "run the team" job. It's a build-the-function job.     You will own how the highest-value players in the business are talked to, upgraded, retained, and rewarded — across every channel, every shift, every market. The team is in place. The tooling is in place. What we need is a leader who can raise the bar on all of it: commercial judgement, coaching quality, communication standards, bonus discipline, segmentation logic, and cross-functional influence.     If you've run VIP or high-net-worth relationship books before — in iGaming, sportsbook, private banking, luxury, or another high-touch premium vertical — and you're ready to own a P&L-relevant function rather than manage a queue, read on.      What you'll own     The team.  Performance, coaching, quality reviews, hiring, structure, shift design. You set the standard for tone, empathy, professionalism, and proactivity — then you make it stick.   The commercial engine.  Upgrade logic, segmentation, bonus-granting discipline, and the calculation frameworks your agents defend every offer against. No improvisation.   The player experience.  Consistency and context-awareness across email, live chat, WhatsApp, and Telegram — regardless of which agent picks up the conversation.   The tooling stack.  Real adoption, not lip service. The team uses what's in front of them, properly.   The commercial narrative.  You represent VIP to the exec team with judgement — flagging risk, defending margin, and shaping strategy alongside Monetisation and BI.       Who you are    A commercial operator first — you understand the tradeoffs between hold, LTV, retention, and short-term margin, and you know when they conflict.  A proven leader of people — you've built and coached VIP or HNW-facing teams, not just been the top individual on one.  Fluent with dashboards and KPIs — not a data scientist, but nobody has to explain a cohort chart to you twice.  Track record with high-value individuals — iGaming preferred, but private banking, luxury retail, concierge, or comparable high-touch premium client backgrounds welcome.  iGaming or sportsbook experience strongly preferred.       What's on offer    Global remit. Real ownership. Genuine influence at the top table.  A crypto-native operator moving faster than the market, with commercial ambition to match.  Competitive base + performance-linked upside, benefits, and flexibility around location.

VERDANCY
Aachen, Germany (RWTH Aachen) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AgTech & Biotechnology

**About Verdancy
**Verdancy is a start up in the making from the Schwaneberg Group at the Institute of Biotechnology of RWTH Aachen University. It develops biodegradable additives that make crop-protection products stick to leaves and last longer. Bio-based microgels carry the active substance and release it on demand, while bi-adhesive peptides anchor the microgel to the leaf wax so the coating survives rain — meaning fewer sprays and less pesticide lost to the environment. A second product line uses bifunctional peptides (antimicrobial peptide + anchor) as peptide-based pesticides in their own right, protected by patent EP3261435B1. The entry market is copper fungicide against grapevine downy mildew, where there is no real alternative today, poor rain resistance is a known problem, and the EU is pushing hard to cut copper use.

**The opportunity
**Built on more than 10 years of university research across six projects (€7m raised, TRL 5), the startup is now being further developed by Susanne Braun (CSO, polymer chemist, carrier systems and formulations) and Atul Kumar (CTO, biotechnologist, protein engineering). Verdancy already has a developed business model, funding secured through May 2027 via the Warp Speed Fund of the Materials Lab Incubator (MerLIn), a successful soybean-rust project and a new €2.4m insect-focused project starting January 2027. What's missing is the business development leadership to found the spin-off company and go after an €80B addressable market (€1.2B in the copper segment alone).

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting!

Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads. You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki.

About the role

The role is focused on the business needs - you'll be working within a cross-functional team, making sure your teammates get the insights needed for their operations. The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Mercura (YC W25) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months. With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US.

About the role

You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked.

That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything.

We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you.

What you will be working on

  • Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building.

  • Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it.

  • Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so.

description:
About SandboxAQ

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. As a Machine Learning Engineer on AQCell, you will build and maintain the models and data infrastructure that power this pipeline.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

About FastSpring:

Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations

Department: Payment Operations | Location: Remote — United States | Reports To: Senior Manager, Payment Operations

Position Overview:

The Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations supports daily payment operations across multiple processors and regions for FastSpring's network of more than 2,500 sellers. The role pairs hands-on operational work — chargeback and PayPal dispute support, issue investigation, and seller-facing resolution — with technical operations analytics across five areas: authorization rates, chargeback rates, data normalization, processing costs, and reconciliation support. It is an entry-to-early-career position for someone curious about how payments work, comfortable in a spreadsheet, and inclined to chase down a number that looks wrong.

Within a year, this person should own recurring analysis in at least one of those five areas, handle disputes independently, and be the person others ask when a number doesn't reconcile — a path that leads toward senior payment operations, payments analytics, or risk and fraud. Payments is a field you learn by doing, and we welcome candidates from varied backgrounds and career paths; curiosity and analytical instinct matter more here than a specific résumé.

  • Investigate Tier I–II payment inquiries involving authorizations, declines, settlements, refunds, disputes, or processor behavior; escalate complex cases and maintain clear handoff notes, including for weekend coverage.
  • Track authorization approval and decline rates across processors, regions, and payment methods, breaking declines down by response code and category to pinpoint where approvals are being lost.
  • Normalize payment data across sources — processor response codes, decline and chargeback categories, and reporting definitions — and run routine data-quality

description:
ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. title: Sales Associate in Teilzeit (m/w/x) Frankfurt Airport (20 Stunden)
description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, die Kunstwelt für alle zu öffnen.

Kunst verändert den Blick auf die Welt. Mit dem Ziel, Kunst zu demokratisieren, hat LUMAS den Kunstmarkt verändert. Unterstützt von 250 Künstlern und einer Community von über 300.000 Kunstliebhabern sind wir heute der globale Marktführer für Kunsteditionen. 
Wir laden Dich ein, Deine Karriereziele mit uns zu teilen. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Persönlichkeiten, die unser Team mit neuen Ideen und Fähigkeiten bereichern. Lass uns gemeinsam die Verbindung zwischen Kunst und Einzelhandel revolutionieren und so Alltag und Kunst zusammenbringen.

Diese Galerie befindet sich im Terminal 3 des Frankfurter Flughafens und die Arbeitszeiten werden sich nach unseren Öffnungszeiten von 06:00 bis 21:30 Uhr richten.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Sales Associate spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Team, indem du aktiv das Kauferlebnis unserer Kunden mitgestaltest. Bringe dein Interesse für Kunst ein und unterstütze uns bei täglichen Aufgaben sowie besonderen Events. 

  • Beratung und Verkauf unserer Kunstwerke mit einer persönlichen Note 
  • Sicherstellung eines unvergesslichen Besuchs- und Kauferlebnisses 
  • Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Durchführung von Galerie-Events 
  • Vielfältige Aufgaben von der Kundenbetreuung bis zum Management des Lagerbestands 


Dein Profil

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Einzelhandel oder einem serviceorientierten Bereich sind von Vorteil 
  • Ein kommunikatives, kundenorientiertes Naturell 
  • Fähigkeit, administrative Aufgaben effizient und strukturiert zu bewältigen 
  • Sehr gute Deut

title: Werkstudent Social Media Marketing & Content Management Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Die gemeinnützige Flossbach von Storch Stiftung engagiert sich mit Passion für die Förderung von Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung. Ziel ist es, möglichst vielen ein selbstbestimmtes und finanziell unabhängiges Leben zu ermöglichen. Gleichzeitig hilft Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung, gesellschaftliche und politische Entwicklungen zu verstehen. So stärkt sie die Menschen, die Gesellschaft und die Demokratie.
 
Vor diesem Hintergrund wurde 2006 die Flossbach von Storch Stiftung gegründet. Ihre Aktivitäten sind in drei Bereiche gegliedert: Projektarbeit, Förderung von Wissenschaft, Forschung und Lehre sowie bildungspolitisches Engagement. Zur Unterstützung des Teams bei der Projektarbeit und um noch mehr Menschen zu erreichen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) in Köln mit 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche für mindestens 6 Monate.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Pflege und Ausbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle (insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn)
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung kreativer Content-Ideen (Text, Bild, Video, Reels) und Serien
  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Abstimmung des Content Calendars
  • Pflege und Aktualisierung unserer Website
  • Interaktion mit unserer Community, Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten
  • Auswertung der Content-Performance


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ideen und Konzepten und verfügst über eine hohe Affinität zu Social Media, insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn
  • Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über Basiskenntnisse im Bereich Wirtschaft und Finanzen
  • Qualifikation: Du bist eingeschriebener Bachelor- ode

Das Data & Automation Team ist Teil der OMR Tech Abteilung und fungiert als Center of Excellence für die Daten- und Prozessoptimierung bei OMR. Was uns dabei leitet, ist bis heute dasselbe: Wir arbeiten nur mit Menschen zusammen, mit denen es wirklich passt, ob im Team oder mit unseren Mandanten. Denn gute Arbeit entsteht dort, wo Vertrauen herrscht, jede Stimme zählt und man gemeinsam Lösungen entwickelt. Diese Haltung macht uns aus und sie eröffnet Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich bei uns einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Deinen eigenen Weg in der Steuerberatung und in unserer Kanzlei zu gehen.

Aufgaben

title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars. Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run.

Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the cost per insight changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions.

That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a digital twin of fermentation at any scale.

We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us.

Now we are hiring the first role dedicated entirely to lab automation. You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here.

This is, in many ways, the role we always wished existed: high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work

title: AI Growth Marketer (m/w/d) - remote

Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Seit wir konsequent mit AI arbeiten, sehen wir deutlich mehr Chancen zu wachsen, als wir bisher angehen können. title: Solution Architect (d/f/m)
description:
Gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment-Tech

Willkommen bei vivenu – dem globalen Vorreiter für Event-Ticketing-Technologie und einem der weltweit schnellst wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen im Live-Entertainment. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren.

Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen.

Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

Als Solution Architect (d/f/m) bei vivenu gehören zu deinen Aufgaben:
  • Konzeptionierung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für individuelle integration gaps, wie API-Anbindungen, Single Sign-On (SSO)-Setups und ERP-Systeme, unter optimaler Nutzung der leistungsstarken Plattform-Features von vivenu
  • Aufbau enger Partnerschaften mit Enterprise-Kunden, um deren bestehende digitale storefronts nahtlos in eine hochmoderne, vollständig auf unseren robusten APIs basierende Headless-Commerce-Architektur zu überführen
  • Durchführung technischer Workshops mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite – von CTOs und IT-Abteilungen bis hin zu externen Digitalagenturen und Ticketin

title: Teamleader Kundservice
description: ___________________________________________________________________________________________ Häng med på resan med Jollyroom – e-handeln som startade år 2010 och nu dominerar Nordens marknad som den största onlinebutiken för barn- och babyprodukter. Vi strävar efter att erbjuda inte bara produkter, utan en total livsstilsupplevelse, för föräldrar i Europa. Med över 2 miljoner nöjda kunder och ett sortiment som omfattar produkter för gravida, nyfödda och barn till 12 år, är vi inte bara en butik, vi är en destination för barnfamiljen. Vi brinner för att göra familjelivet enklare, roligare och mer inspirerande genom att erbjuda de bästa varumärkena och de senaste produkterna. Men vi nöjer oss inte där - vi är på en ständig resa mot att bli bäst i Europa. Vår nya bas, Campus Jollyroom strax utanför Göteborg, är en plats där innovation möter passion. Här huserar vårt stora, moderna kontor, toppmoderna lager på 55 000 kvm och ett showroom som tar kundupplevelsen till en ny nivå. Vi tror på att investera i våra 400 medarbetare, därför har vi även ett välutrustat stort personalgym på plats för att se till att vårt team är i toppform för att möta våra högt uppsatta mål. Men det slutar inte där. Med fysiska butiker i Stockholm och Oslo expanderar vi vårt grepp över den europeiska marknaden. Vi är inte bara med i spelet - vi är här för att vinna. Och du kan vara en del av det här vinnande laget. Vi letar ständigt efter talanger som delar vår passion och vår drivkraft att göra skillnad. Så om du är redo att vara en del av något stort, om du är hungrig efter utmaningar och redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär, då är Jollyroom platsen för dig.     Är du en driven, målinriktad och erfaren ledare som är redo för nästa etapp i ditt arbetsliv? Då kan du vara en av våra nästa Teamleaders på Kundserviceavdelningen! Just nu letar vi efter en Teamleader som säkerhetsställer att våra kunder får oslagbar service via mail och telefon samt att våra medarbetare utvecklas och presterar enligt uppsatta mål.    Din uppgift som Teamleader är att genom coachning och uppföljning se till så att ditt team uppnår våra KPI:er som i slutänden förbättrar kundupplevelsen. Din uppgift är även att säkerställa hantering utav olika administrativa ansvarsområden inom upsatta KPI:er, samt säkerställa utveckling i vårt kundservicesystem. I arbetet ingår det att ha nära samarbete med övriga Teamleaders och avdelningar för att ständigt utveckla verksamheten.   Dina arbetsuppgifter:     Löpande hantera personalfrågor.   Löpande hålla coachningssamtal, hälsosamtal och medarbetarsamtal.   Följer upp data och statistik för att säkerställa att avdelningen och medarbetare uppnår sina mål och arbetar mot verksamhetens mål.   Initierar och driver projekt för att utveckla och förbättra vår kundservice.   Ingår i ledningsgruppen för avdelningen och har ett nära samarbete med övriga Teamleaders och Head of Customer Service.   Personalrelaterade uppgifter, t.ex. godkänna löner, intervjua slutkandidater

Du står ikke alene med ansvaret. Du får en tæt sparringspartner i en erfaren servicelederkollega, ligesom vores koordinator hjælper med at skabe struktur og flow i hverdagen. description: ZARA  ist eine internationale Modekette der spanischen Inditex-Gruppe. Mit über 2.000 Filialen in mehr als 90 Ländern sind wir eines der erfolgreichsten Textilunternehmen weltweit. Con una forte presenza a livello europeo e una lunga storia di successo, Econocom offre un ambiente dinamico e stimolante per coloro che condividono la nostra passione per la tecnologia e per i valori dell’economia circolare.      Descrizione del Ruolo:  Stiamo cercando un/una  Account Manager  che abbia passione per le relazioni commerciali e voglia contribuire concretamente alla crescita del business. La persona avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare un portafoglio di clienti, costruendo relazioni solide e durature e individuando nuove opportunità di sviluppo. Attraverso una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, proporrà soluzioni e servizi in linea con i loro bisogni e con la strategia aziendale, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali e alla crescita sostenibile del business.      Responsabilità Chiave:   Business Development   Identificare opportunità di upselling, cross-selling e ampliamento dei servizi.  Promuovere il portafoglio soluzioni e servizi dell’azienda presso i clienti assegnati.  Sviluppare piani commerciali per la crescita degli account.      Commercial Management   Predisporre offerte commerciali e negoziare condizioni economiche e contrattuali.  Gestire rinnovi contrattuali e attività di retention.  Garantire il raggiungimento dei target di fatturato e marginalità.      Client Relationship   Costruire e mantenere relazioni di lungo periodo con decision maker e stakeholder chiave.  Organizzare e condurre periodiche business review con i clienti.  Gestire eventuali escalation commerciali.      Internal Coordination   Collaborare con i team di delivery e operation per garantire la corretta esecuzione dei servizi.  Assicurare l’allineamento tra impegni commerciali, livelli di servizio e aspettative del cliente.  Favorire la collaborazione tra le funzioni coinvolte nella gestione dell’account.       Qualifiche:    Laurea o cultura equivalente in discipline economiche, commerciali o tecniche.  Esperienza pluriennale nella gestione di clienti B2B.  Conoscenza delle dinamiche di account management e customer relationship management.       Come Candidarsi:  Se possiedi le qualifiche richieste e sei pronto ad affrontare questa sfida, invia il tuo CV e la lettera di presentazione a recruiting@econocom.com o direttamente da LinkedIn.       Informativa ai sensi dell’art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679     Ai sensi dell’art. 13 del Regolamento (UE) 2016/679 (GDPR) la informiamo che i Suoi dati personali saranno trattati da    Econocom Lease Solutions S.p.A.   , Titolare del trattamento, prevalentemente con mezzi informatici, per le attività di reclutamento e selezione del personale e saranno utilizzati esclusivamente per ricontattarla e pianificare un primo colloquio. title: Senior Business Operations Manager
description: The Opportunity   Unity's Entertainment CRO org is the growth and customer engagement engine for our Games and Entertainment customers. Within it, the Operations group exists to bring analytical rigor to how we set strategy and make decisions, ensure every customer-facing team is equipped to execute, and modernize how we engage with customers at scale.  We are hiring a Senior Business Operations Manager to modernize how our sales, success, support, and enablement functions run. Your job is to diagnose why a process isn’t working and design something better. The right answer is sometimes a redesigned process flow, and sometimes automation, a new system capability, or an AI-powered experience. You will take the reins on implementation and see it through. Sometimes, you will need to build automations and internal tools yourself and scale the larger ones with systems and data teams.  What you’ll do    Lead the implementation of AI-driven customer support experience, from designing the customer journey, managing the Help Center experience, to the implementation of customer support AI chatbot   Establish a structured feedback loop between support and relevant product teams that surfaces recurring issues and drives resolution at the root cause  Ensure customer-facing teams are enablement  Partner with support leaders to establish a process for maintaining the Knowledge Base that optimizes for self-service, AI enhancements, and support agent contributions  Drive the support and customer success, partnering with data teams on metric definitions, dashboard design, and automated reporting  Build automations and internal tools hands-on, and scale the larger builds in partnership with systems and data teams    What we’re looking for    Strong customer empathy and an appreciation for what makes a customer’s experience easy and seamless  Process- and detail-oriented with proven experience in redesigning operational processes and delivering measurable improvement  Structured thinking, with the ability to take a vague problem and produce a clear diagnosis, a set of options, and a defensible recommendation   Track record of driving cross-functional programs from concept through adoption, working through influence rather than authority  Technical skillsets or title: Digital Experience Manager Intelligence & Research
description: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.   About The Role   Do you aspire to shape the future of digital travel experiences through customer intelligence, behavioural analytics, and innovation?  As Manager, Digital Experience Intelligence & Research, you will lead the research and analytics capability that drives customer-centric decision-making across Riyadh Air's digital ecosystem. You will transform customer behaviour, market trends, and digital performance data into actionable insights that influence product strategy, experience design, and business outcomes.  Working closely with Product, Experience Design, Technology, Data, and Commercial teams, you will identify opportunities for optimisation, validate concepts through research and experimentation, and provide strategic recommendations that enhance customer journeys across web, mobile, and emerging digital channels.  You will champion evidence-based decision-making by leveraging qualitative and quantitative research, behavioural insights, customer feedback, and industry best practices. Your expertise will help shape future digital experiences, support innovation initiatives, and ensure Riyadh Air remains at the forefront of customer experience excellence.  This is your opportunity to help build one of the world's most innovative airlines and redefine the future of digital customer experiences.   About You   Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in Customer Insights, UX Research, Digital Analytics, Behavioural Science, Market Research, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering customer-focused business outcomes.  You possess strong experience in research methodologies, customer journey analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and translating complex data into clear, meaningful insights and recommendations.  We'd love to hear from you even more if you can demonstrate experience in AI-enabled research, digital experience optimisation, customer intelligence platforms, and agile product environments.  You will be recognised for your strategic thinking, communication skills, innovative mindset, and ability to influence stakeholders while driving a culture of continuous improvement.  This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.  Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

title: Operations Manager
description: Transcom is a global community of customer experience experts – nimble, driven, and committed to the brands we serve. Please include a full CV in English .     At Transcom, we’re relentlessly committed. To our clients and each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. Taking the potential they have today and turning it into skills for the future. Getting recognized for working hard, being a team player, and supporting others. Championing positive, lasting change in their teams and communities. That’s just how we are at Transcom. Here we care and root for each other. You’re included, just as you are, from day one. And with the right mindset, there’s no end to how far we can go together.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: At Aceve, we back the builders of society. Founded in the Nordics and growing across Europe, we build digital tools for the people who construct and maintain our physical world - giving electricians, plumbers, and contractors back their time, clarity, and confidence. With over 900 employees across 8 countries, leading brands in 7 customer markets, and more than €100M in revenue, we're on an ambitious growth journey, and we're just getting started. We're an AI-first company, and we work with grit, openness, and a good dose of joy.   Role Purpose   As our Customer Success Manager, you'll make sure customers keep getting real value from Next, our project management and financial control platform for construction companies. Next gives project managers and site teams visibility into project economics, budgets, costs, revenue and progress, both on individual projects and across the business. You'll do that by keeping a close eye on customer health, engagement and usage, and catching risks and opportunities early.  This is a role for someone who wants to help build how Customer Success works, not just fit into it. Building the function is something the whole team owns together, and we're looking for someone who gets a real charge out of that. Someone who's comfortable when the path is a bit foggy and can bring structure to the mess.  We think one-to-many. The goal isn't just solving things for one customer at a time, it's finding ways to make things better for several customers at once. We'd rather build something that scales than lean on one-off 1:1 meetings.   Key Responsibilities     Proactively monitor customer health, engagement and usage, flag and act on risks before they escalate.  Think one-to-many: look for ways to improve things for several customers at once, rather than relying on one-off 1:1 meetings.  Run regular touchpoints and spot opportunities for customers to get more value.  Drive product adoption, retention and renewal, working closely with Account Management.  Be the customer's internal advocate, feeding insights back to Product and Support.  Help customers navigate product changes and new ways of working.  Help build and improve how Customer Success works. This is a shared team responsibility, not one role's job.  Share what you learn from customers so the whole team can keep improving.     Success Measures     Customer Health Score and proactive risk management  Product usage, engagement and adoption  Customer satisfaction and NPS  Retention, churn and renewal outcomes  Strength of customer relationships and stakeholder communication  Contribution to improving Customer Success processes and best practices     Required Competencies & Skills     Able to read product usage and customer data to spot risks and opportunities early. title: CRM & AI Automation Manager
description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir in unserem Hauptsitz in Rotkreuz per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung dich als:      CRM & AI Automation Manager (m/w/d) 100%       Deine Mission   Du gestaltest die daten- und KI-gestützte, hyperpersonalisierte Kundenkommunikation unserer Marken und sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zur richtigen Zeit mit der passenden Botschaft über den richtigen Kanal erreichen. Dafür verbindest du Kundenverständnis, CRM und Technologie, übersetzt Kundendaten in relevante Zielgruppen und leitest daraus personalisierte Kampagnen sowie konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Gemeinsam mit der IT sowie internen und externen Partnern setzt du diese in automatisierten Anwendungen und Prozessen um. So schaffst du personalisierte Kundenerlebnisse, stärkst die Kundenbindung und machst unser Marketing messbar wirksamer und effizienter.      Deine Hauptaufgaben    Entwicklung daten- und KI-gestützter Marketing- und CRM-Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Customer Lifecycles: von der Analyse von Kundenverhalten und Potenzialen bis zur personalisierten Ansprache über die passenden Kanäle  Analyse von Kunden-, Kampagnen- und Transaktionsdaten sowie Identifikation von Potenzialen für Kundenbindung, Cross-Selling, Up-Selling und Reaktivierung. Darauf basierend: Definition von Zielgruppen, Selektionslogiken und automatisierten Marketingmassnahmen  Konzeption und Optimierung automatisierter Customer Journeys für die mobilezone Gruppe, damit unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zur richtigen Zeit die relevantesten Angebote, Inhalte und Services erhalten  Strategische Weiterentwicklung des mobilezone Club mit datenbasierten Mehrwerten für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden durch personalisierte Benefits, Angebote und Kommunikationsmassnahmen  Vorantreiben der Transformation unserer heutigen CRM-Landschaft hin zu einer KI-gestützten Plattform für hyperpersonalisierte Kundenkommunikation und Erschliessen neuer Möglichkeiten für eine skalierbare, datengetriebene Kundenansprache  Identifikation und Implementierung von KI-Anwendungen entlang des gesamten Marketingprozesses: von Datenanalyse und Zielgruppenbildung über Content-Erstellung und Sprachadaption bis zur automatisierten Kampagnensteuerung und Erfolgsmessung  Verantwortung für CRM-, Automations- und Transformationsprojekte in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Kampagnenmanagement, IT sowie externen Technologiepartnern  Weiterentwicklung der Anbindung von KI-Tools, KI-Agenten und neuen Datenquellen an unsere Marketing- und CRM-Plattformen, damit Daten, Prozesse und Schnittstellen optimal aufeinander abgestimmt sind  Verantwortung für Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketing- und Kundendaten als saubere Grundlage für erfolgreiche Personalisierung, Automatisierung und KI-Anwendungen       Das bringst Du mit:    Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Weiterbildung in Marketing, CRM, Data Analytics, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.  Erfahrung in CRM, datenbasie

title: Customer Success & Implementation Manager (AI B2B SaaS | German & French)
description: Willst Du unsere preisgekrönte Künstliche Intelligenz von morgen mitgestalten, die schon heute das Arbeitsleben von Tausenden von Menschen in acht Europäischen Ländern verbessert? Werde ein unverzichtbarer Teil unseres etablierten und dennoch dynamischen Startup-Teams!   Wir sind ein spezialisierter SaaS-Anbieter einer innovativen und datengetriebenen SaaS-Plattform zur Digitalisierung und Optimierung von Prozessen im Automotive Aftersales.   Unsere Kunden sind Werkstätten, Händlergruppen und international tätige Aftersalesketten. Unser Ziel: smartere Abläufe, bessere Entscheidungen und messbare Effizienzgewinne durch eine datengestützte und selbstlernende KI. Mit einem digitalen Zwilling bilden wir ganze Prozessstrassen (insb. im Bereich Karosserie & Lack) realitätsgetreu ab und finden mit einer Real-time Optimerung Potenziale, die sonst im Verborgenen bleiben. Hilf mit und verbessere die aspaara-KI um sie zur Killerplattform im Automotive Aftersales zu machen.   Effiziente und ressourcenschonende Lösungen liegen uns sehr am Herzen. Deshalb haben wir uns verpflichtet, ein 100% klimaneutrales Unternehmen zu sein. title: Global Sustainability Market Engagement Manager
description: The Opportunity   As Global Sustainability Market Engagement Manager, you will help the organisation systematically anticipate, understand, and respond to evolving customer and stakeholder sustainability expectations.  The role combines sustainability expertise with market and customer insight. You will develop structured and consistent approaches for managing sustainability-related requests, translate external signals into actionable business insights, and support customer-facing teams in strategic engagements.   How You'll Make An Impact    Market & Customer Sustainability Intelligence      Gather and structure sustainability expectations, requirements, and emerging priorities from customers and key stakeholders.   Monitor relevant market developments, regulatory evolution, competitive trends, and recurring sustainability themes.   Identify early signals, opportunities, and risks that may affect competitiveness, market access, and customer needs.   Translate complex inputs into clear, actionable insights for strategic and commercial decision-making.     Sustainability Request & Response Process Development      Develop and continuously improve a structured approach for managing sustainability-related customer and stakeholder requests.   Define clear intake, prioritisation, coordination, escalation, and response pathways.   Enable effective collaboration across Sustainability, Marketing & Sales, Portfolio, Product Management, Supply Chain, Communications, Legal, and other relevant functions.     Customer-Focused Sustainability Value      Translate sustainability capabilities, initiatives, and performance into clear and customer-relevant business value.   Support the development of sustainability value propositions and fact-based messages for customers and market stakeholders.   Contribute, where relevant, to the assessment of sustainability-related value drivers, business benefits, and competitive differentiators.   Help commercial and business teams communicate sustainability topics in a clear and business-oriented way.     Strategic Insight and Business Input      Translate customer and market insights into input for sustainability strategy, materiality assessments, portfolio development, and innovation.   Provide fact-based perspectives on evolving stakeholder expectations and their potential business implications.   Support the identification of opportunities where sustainability can create customer value and contribute to long-term growth.     Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement      Act as a bridge between Sustainability and customer-facing business functions.   Facilitate collaboration across functions and regions in a complex global organisation.   Support capability building by providing practical guidance, tools, and frameworks for sustainability discussions with customers and stakeholders.   Foster alignment while respecting established governance and decision-making responsibilities.     Your background

Du vil arbejde tæt på beslutningstagere og spille en nøglerolle i at udvikle vores kunders forretning gennem velfunderede og værdiskabende løsninger. Hvad du skal have med     Har erfaring med B2B- og løsningssalg samt med at opbygge og udvikle langsigtede kunderelationer.   Har en teknisk salgsbaggrund fx som salgsingeniør eller lignende.   Kan sætte dig ind i kundens forretning og se sammenhænge mellem driftsmæssige, økonomiske og tekniske behov.   Trives med et stort ansvar og møder kunderne med rådgivning, der tager udgangspunkt i deres behov og mulige løsninger.   Tager selv initiativ til at identificere nye salgsmuligheder og skabe yderligere værdi i eksisterende kunderelationer.   Sætter pris på en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor dine dage tilbringes ude hos kunderne.   Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med CRM-systemer og bruger data aktivt til at planlægge og følge op på salgsindsatsen.   Erfaring med Off- og on-shore kunder er en fordel.   Er bosat i Trekantområdet.     Hvad det giver dig   Hos Hilti får du et udviklende og meningsfuldt job med gode karrieremuligheder. Vi tilbyder:    Fuldt ansvar for nøglekunder med direkte indflydelse på kundens og Hilti Danmarks resultater.   Grundigt introduktionsforløb med bl.a. salgstræning, herunder to ugers salgstræning fordelt på to ophold på vores regionale træningscenter i Manchest

description: Är du redo för nästa utmaning? Får du energi av omväxling och snabbt tempo i en föränderlig miljö? Vår styrka är vår bredd av kompetens och vårt breda utbud av tjänster. Vi samarbetar mycket med övriga avdelningar och discipliner i regionen och delar lokal med både VS och Vitvaror. Är affärsmässig och engagerad ledare som motiveras av att utveckla inom installationsbranschen samt känsla och intresse för säljarbete och kundrelationer.  Arbetar strukturerat, tar egna initiativ och kommunicerar tydligt med kunder, kollegor och medarbetare.     Arbetet som servicechef kräver ofta snabba beslut och ageranden vilket medför att du bör vara stresstålig och ha god problemlösningsförmåga. Mycket stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.   Meriterande:      Har lokal förankring i Perstorp-Klippan-Hässleholm-Örkelljunga området med omnejd.  Har du även ett befintligt kontaktnät inom dessa områden är det starkt meriterande.  Du har en god struktur i ditt arbete och lätt för att kommunicera och samarbeta.
