title: Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships
description:
Headquarters:  San Diego, CA, USA
      URL:   http://www.shoutaboutus.com 
 

 Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships 
 Shout About Us · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time · 60K - 80K USD 
 About the role 
 We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own and grow our most strategic accounts. You’ll own the technical relationship with our API partners, from their first technical evaluation through implementation and ongoing support. 
 Reporting directly to the CRO, you’ll be the first dedicated post-sales professional at Shout About Us, responsible for making sure our biggest customers deploy, expand, and stay. Our ICP is founders, product teams, and engineering teams.  
 This is a hands-on role. On any given day, you might join a prospect’s technical discovery call, troubleshoot an API request with a partner engineer, coordinate a fix with our engineering team, or improve a quickstart guide. You’ll also help build the documentation and processes that make each new integration easier than the last. 
 Location and hours 
 Remote, anywhere. Our standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. US Eastern Time, including a lunch break. Occasional calls outside these hours are required for APAC partners and key implementation milestones. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 
 Own a portfolio of 10-15 strategic accounts. Be the primary technical contact for API partners, keep stakeholders informed, and follow issues through to resolution. 
 
 
 Support technical evaluations. Join sales calls, demonstrate API capabilities, understand the partner’s requirements, and explain how an integration would work. 
 
 
 Lead partner implementations. Turn requirements into a clear integration plan, guide developers through setup and testing, and track progress through launch. 
 
 
 Troubleshoot directly. Investigate requests, responses, logs, authentication issues, and integration behavior before escalating to engineering. 
 
 
 Work closely with engineering. Provide clear reproduction steps, relevant evidence, and customer impact when an issue needs deeper investigation. 
 
 
 Improve the developer experience. Create and maintain API guides, Postman collections, code examples, FAQs, and onboarding playbooks. 
 
 
 Identify recurring friction. Share partner feedback and integration patterns that can inform product improvements. 
 
 
 Lead expansion efforts. Cross-sell new features and products as a natural extension of the relationship, not a separate motion.  
 
 
 What we’re looking for 
 
 
 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role or equivalent at an API-first or dev-tools company 
 
 
 Strong practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate limits. 
 
 
 Comfort using Postman or curl, reading logs, and writing or adapting small code examples in a language such as JavaScript or Python. 
 
 
 Experience driving adoption inside complex orgs: navigating the gap between the buyer who signed and the team

AYAN reads how these models answer  real buyer questions, shows a brand where it is recommended and where a competitor takes its place,  and turns every gap into a fix that lands with the person or page that closes the sale.  Four founders. Live clients in retail, beauty and hospitality across the Gulf and Europe. Hiring the first two people who are not founders.      Why this role exists   Our first clients have signed. They did not buy a login. They bought a result: their brand read differently  by AI inside a set window, KPIs that move, and a story they will put their name on.  You own that, from onboarding to published case study. The founders sell and build. You make sure  what was sold gets delivered and what was built gets used. Three quarters of your time is clients. The  rest is running the project plan for AYAN's own marketing: launch, events, content, PR. When both are  on fire, the client is the one you put out.      A realistic Tuesday   09:10. A client's marketing lead messages you. The fix their web team promised last week has not  shipped and their monthly read is in three days. Paul is in a pitch. Chakir is in Riyadh. You have the  client's org chart, the platform, and forty minutes before your next call. Nobody is coming to tell you what  to do.  If that excites you more than it scares you, keep reading.      Who you are   Two to three years, probably agency or consulting, running accounts where the client was demanding  and the deadline was real. You have never worked on AI and that is fine. You are curious enough to  learn it in month one and clear enough to explain it to a marketing director in month two.   •  You finish things. An ownerless project finds you and you take it.   •  You find the fix before you find someone to escalate to.   •  No process yet? You write it.   •  You read a spreadsheet and a client's mood with the same attention.   •  English a client never questions. Arabic is a real advantage.  One more thing. Whatever channel you apply through, make your first line the last brand an AI assistant recommended to you, and whether you bought it. That is how we know you got this far.      Six months in    •  Every open fix has a named owner on the client side, and you know which ones are stuck and why.   •  One client has agreed in writing to a named case study, and you drove the proof points behind it.   •  Onboarding takes half the time it does today, because you rewrote it.   •  We hear about client problems from you before the client tells us. title: AI Success Partner (Customer Success)
description: About the Company      About FileAIFileAI is building the future of intelligent document processing. We help enterprises automate extraction, classification, and analysis of unstructured data at scale. Our platform combines proprietary large language models with deep workflow integration to turn documents into structured, actionable output — in seconds, not hours. We're a fast-growing team with customers across financial services, insurance, legal, and logistics, and we're backed by leading regional investors.      About the Role      We're looking for a AI Success Partner to own the post-sale experience for a portfolio of FileAI customers. You'll be the primary point of contact from onboarding through renewal, ensuring customers achieve measurable outcomes and expand their use of the platform over time. This is a foundational role on a growing Customer Success team — you'll have direct exposure to product, engineering, and sales leadership, with a clear path to senior CSM or account management responsibilities.      Responsibilities       Own onboarding: Lead new customers through implementation, from kickoff to first value, ensuring smooth integration and clear adoption milestones.  Drive outcomes: Work with customers to define success metrics, track progress against goals, and demonstrate ROI throughout the relationship.  Build relationships: Develop trusted advisor status with key stakeholders — from operations leads to C-suite sponsors — through proactive engagement and strategic counsel.  Expand revenue: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your book, partnering with Sales to grow account value.  Protect revenue: Monitor health signals, address churn risk early, and own the renewal process end-to-end.  Be the voice of the customer: Distill customer feedback into actionable product insights and advocate for customer needs internally.  Improve processes: Contribute to playbooks, templates, and CS tooling as we scale the function.       Required Skills       1–3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role at a B2B SaaS or technology company.  Track record of owning outcomes: You've managed a book of business, hit retention or expansion targets, or led customers through complex implementations.  Strong communicator: You can translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences and build rapport quickly across seniority levels.  Organised and detail-oriented: You manage multiple workstreams without dropping balls, and you're comfortable in CRM and project management tools.  Problem-solver: You diagnose root causes, escalate effectively, and don't stop until the customer is unblocked.  Comfort with ambiguity: We're early-stage and evolving fast. You thrive in environments where processes are being built, not just followed.       What We Offer       Competitive salary and performance-based bonus  Unlimited leave  Lunch Perks  Direct access to founders and leadership

title: Lead Implementation manager
description: Lead Implementation Manager       About Yomly   Yomly is a Dubai-based HR and payroll automation SaaS provider serving organisations across the GCC and beyond. We help customers turn agreed requirements into a working service: confident platform adoption, reliable payroll and a clear handover into ongoing support.      The opportunity   We are looking for a senior, hands-on implementation leader to personally deliver high-value customer projects, guide our delivery team and strengthen how Yomly manages implementations.  You will lead projects from discovery and agreed scope through go-live and early stabilisation, bringing discipline to planning, portfolio visibility and customer communication.  You will work with a team of six delivery colleagues and a Training Consultant. Professional Services is a separate engineering and customisation function: Engineering owns technical feasibility, estimates and what gets built; you own the customer plan, scope and delivery outcome.  Your primary contribution is trusted hands-on delivery. You will normally own one or two substantial implementations at a time, delegating defined activities while retaining ownership of decisions, progress and customer outcomes. Build workable plans covering configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, training, cutover and stabilisation.  Run customer workshops and delivery meetings; resolve ambiguity and address difficult conversations directly.  Manage scope changes, effort and delivery forecasts as customer readiness or dependencies change.   Manage delivery constraints   Identify gaps between customer expectations and supported product capability during scoping.  Work with Sales, Product and Professional Services to agree a supported approach, workaround, scope change or escalation.  Validate technical feasibility and development commitments before incorporating them into a customer plan.  Contribute delivery judgement to higher-risk opportunities before signature and improve sales-to-implementation handovers.  Keep paused projects under active review, with clear owners and restart conditions.   Improve delivery across the portfolio   Maintain an accurate view of active implementations, including ownership, milestones, confidence, effort, risks, blockers and decisions required.  Lead short delivery reviews focused on exceptions, workload and actions.  Establish practical, lightweight delivery practices: reusable plans, scope records, readiness checks and handover criteria.  Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support and Customer Success to resolve recurring delivery issues.   Lead and develop the team   Allocate work according to capability and capacity.  Review plans and customer updates, provide feedback and coach colleagues through live delivery situations.  Manage

title: Vice President of Account Management
description: About Us   At Office Ally, we've been revolutionizing healthcare administration since our inception. What started as a clearinghouse focused on simplifying insurance claims processing for healthcare providers has grown into a full-suite healthcare technology company. We offer a range of affordable, cloud-based revenue cycle management solutions –from eligibility verification and claims management to revenue recovery and payment processing –that help healthcare organizations of all sizes streamline operations and reduce administrative burdens so they can focus on what matters most: patient care.  In April 2026, Office Ally acquired Jopari Solutions, Inc, a leader in straight-through electronic claims processing for Property & Casualty (P&C), Commercial, and Government healthcare. Jopari brings deep industry expertise and innovative enterprise payment solutions that are transforming how disbursements are handled across the insurance ecosystem. Together, we are expanding our capabilities across the full healthcare transaction lifecycle, connecting claims, payments, and data exchange to deliver a more seamless and efficient experience for providers, payers, and partners.  At the core of our company are four key values that guide our mission and work:     Ownership : We take pride in our responsibilities, driving results and taking accountability for the success of our projects.    Empowerment : We believe in giving our team the autonomy and support to make decisions that lead to innovative solutions.    Innovation : We continuously seek new and better ways to improve healthcare administration, embracing creativity and forward-thinking technology.    Transparent Communication : Open, honest communication is at the heart of our collaborations, internally and with our clients, ensuring alignment and trust.      About the Role   This position is responsible for taking full ownership of customer growth, retention, and satisfaction—focusing primarily on Office Ally's top 250 customers by revenue and revenue potential. This executive will be responsible for building and scaling a results-driven account management organization that drives impact where it matters most. This position will lead hiring, define KPIs, implement structured best practices, and actively engage with high-value customers both remotely and in person to maximize long-term partnerships and lifetime value   What You'll Do    Strategy & Transformation       Create and implement an account management function to support the business to include processes that influence claims submission timelines and revenue realization.    Build and execute a scalable strategy that supports company growth and delivers measurable impact.    Define KPIs and reporting frameworks to track performance (e.g. NRR, churn, CSAT, NPS).       Team Leadership      Lead, grow, and develop a high-performing Account Management team   Foster a customer-centric culture of accountability, continuous improvement

The role

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, engineering management, or a senior technical role involving the delivery of complex cross-team initiatives.

  5. Proven experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple engineering teams

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Engineering, EU
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey.

title: Overhead Line (OHL) Design engineer
description:
Power Networks provides high quality consultancy services within distribution network (cable and overhead lines) and transmission (cable). We support our clients throughout every stage of the process — from early feasibility studies to design, execution, and project management. Our expertise also includes market, regulatory, and environmental analysis. Today, our work spans overhead lines and underground cables.

At Power Networks, we are approximately 30 employees located across our offices in Stockholm, Göteborg, Skellefteå, Linköping, Karlstad, Uppsala, Karlskrona, Kalmar and Jönköping. 

As an Overhead Line (OHL) Design engineer at WSP, you will experience a great variety in your work, engaging in projects for multiple clients and network owners. Typical projects involve design, construction, and calculations within the overhead line segment, covering voltage levels from 30 kV to 130 kV.

Some of your responsibilies will include:

  • Lead or contribute to overhead line design for medium voltage grids.
  • Perform tower spotting, line profiling, and routing studies.
  • Conduct sag and tension calculations according to international or Scandinavian standards.
  • Coordinate with Swedish internal teams.
  • Ensure technical compliance, quality, and design optimization.

The team works together closely to achieve project goals while continuously sharing knowledge and experience to foster growth.

At WSP, we offer exciting opportunities to work on a diverse range of overhead line projects, both big and small. You have the flexibility to focus on what drives you and supports your professional development. With colleagues spread across Sweden, you will collaborate with highly skilled professionals in various specialties. We strongly encourage close teamwork, even when working remotely.

In this role you can be placed at any of WSP’s offices in Sweden or where WSP has offices globally.

To succeed in this role, we believe that you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.
  • At least three years experience in overhead power line design (33–130 kV).
  • Strong competence in tower spotting or sag/tension calculations.
  • Familiarity with PLS-CADD or similar design tools is a strong advantage.
  • Prior experience working on European or Scandinavian utility projects is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AutoCAD or Microstation. If you have experience in Icetow, AvCAD or similar programs, it is a merit.
  • Previous experience working as a consultant is also considered a plus.

Additionally, we consider it a merit if you have familiarity with AMA standards, construction, and workplace safety regulations.

We operate in an international environment, so it is important that you are comfortable communicating in English. Swedish i

About Luo

 

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

 

After becoming a leading player in a few markets in record time, we are looking to grow our engineering team and keep expanding the financial infrastructure for FX and cross-border payments in Africa.

 

Role overview

 

As Infrastructure & Security Lead, you will join a small team of experienced engineers and be responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure and its security controls. You will work directly with our CTO to build the foundations that keep LuoPay secure, reliable, and compliant as we scale. The scope covers our GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tooling, as well as the security and compliance program that regulators, partners, and customers depend on.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Analyze our infrastructure and map security risks.

  • Write clear, concise design documents to share infrastructure targets with the rest of the engineering team.

  • Use Terraform to evolve our GCP infrastructure.

  • Use GCP-native security tooling to protect our network, services and databases within GCP.

description:
Imagine this. You are helping build the electronic foundation behind advanced aerospace and defence systems, making sure every component, symbol, footprint, and schematic detail is accurate before it reaches hardware.

As an Engineering Intern, you will work hands-on with Altium Designer and support our electronics engineers in creating and maintaining high-quality PCB design data. This is an opportunity to move beyond university projects and work with real engineering hardware where precision and attention to detail matter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

  • Create, review, and maintain electronic components, schematic symbols, footprints, and library data in Altium Designer
  • Read schematics and component datasheets to ensure design data accurately reflects manufacturer specifications
  • Support engineers with PCB design activities and help maintain clean, consistent, and reliable component libraries
  • Check existing components for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they make their way into hardware
  • Help improve library management, component validation, and engineering workflows
  • Use scripting and automation where useful to make repetitive checks faster and more reliable

title: Multidisciplinary Studio Internship - Art, Engineering & Communication (Berlin)
description:
Studio Apelbaum, founded by artist and engineer Jonathan Apelbaum, brings painting, technology, sound and people into the same space. Our work begins with stories of intimacy, memory and identity and grows through a team of makers, engineers, musicians, performers and writers. We are building a new 150 m² studio at Osloer Straße 16–17 in the historic Umspannwerk Christiania, with a workshop and our own exhibition space.

Our cognitive paintings are oil paintings whose images shift with light, movement and sound through custom LED systems and software. Building these paintings and building the new studio are equally important parts of the internship. Both ask us to work with our hands, solve problems together and learn across disciplines.

Our team crosses disciplines: Jonathan Apelbaum (painting and artistic direction), Thore Bartholomäus (co-owner and main engineer), James Calvert (mechanics and mechatronics), Fabian Wetekamp (software), Titouan Duflo (engineering, performance and AV), Clément Royon (music and soundscape) and malice. (a French collective from Clermont-Ferrand), Lucie Froehlich (fabrication and animation), Aysu Naz Atalay (writing), Valeria Loseva (building), and Alexandra Psijas (design). We also work with choreographer Matilde Flor Usinger and musician Forgotten Sounds to shape how an exhibition moves into the night.

Our own series of ambitious, invitation-only exhibitions and events is central to the new studio. We design and build adaptable furniture in steel and oak so the same room can hold work, an exhibition or a dinner. We make the artworks, shape the space, invite our guests and welcome them ourselves. With Clément Royon's music, an exhibition can slowly change its rhythm; with Forgotten Sounds, it can move into a party. This way of working grows from Jonathan's experience in queer and club culture. Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Software) (all genders)
description:
Your mission

As our Quality Assurance Engineer (Software), you will help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of ProGlove’s connected solutions across embedded and IoT devices, mobile applications, front-end experiences and back-end services.

You will take ownership of quality assurance within the team, combining thoughtful manual testing with effective automation. By challenging assumptions, investigating complex system behavior and continuously improving how we test, you will help us deliver dependable products to our customers.

In this role, you will:

  • Take ownership of QA processes within the team and champion quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze end-to-end system architectures, user flows and integrations to identify risks and gaps in test coverage.
  • Create clear and concise test plans based on product and technical requirements and document them in TestRail.
  • Plan and execute functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • Contribute to our automation frameworks by designing and implementing new automated tests and maintaining existing test suites.
  • Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing where it adds value.
  • Configure and maintain dedicated test environments and test data and support performance and load testing when required.
  • Share findings transparently, raise risks early and collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Continuously improve our testing approaches, tools and ways of working.

title: Product Manager - EXOtube
description:
Introduction

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across 48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube. Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects, becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand.

You bring many years of audit experience and use it to expand our platform conceptually. title: Gestionnaire de la stratégie d'engagement client
description: Description De L'entreprise   Nous sommes RCL - Reitmans Canada Limitée. Depuis 1926, nous faisons partie intégrante du paysage de la mode au Canada et, aujourd’hui, nous élevons plus que jamais nos marques emblématiques – Reitmans, RW&CO et PENN. Penningtons.  Notre vision est de donner aux Canadiens et Canadiennes les moyens de s’affirmer avec confiance, et notre mission est de créer des collections au style et à la qualité sans compromis, pour tous.  Avec près de 400 magasins à travers le pays et des collections conçues ici même, au Canada, nous offrons une expérience client exceptionnelle. Ce qui nous inspire ? Une vision claire, un engagement inébranlable envers nos clients et la passion de nos milliers d’employés à travers le pays.   Description Du Poste   L’opportunité  Chez RCL, nous bâtissons la prochaine génération de croissance client pour Reitmans, RW&CO. et Penningtons — trois marques canadiennes emblématiques avec une ambition claire : repenser la façon dont nous créons des liens avec nos clientes, les mobilisons et faisons évoluer leur relation avec nos marques.  Et nous bâtissons l’équipe pour y arriver.  Nous sommes à la recherche de trois Gestionnaires de la stratégie d’engagement client pour se joindre à notre équipe Engagement client et fidélisation et transformer les données et la connaissance client en croissance, fidélisation et valeur à long terme.  À l’intersection de l’expérience client, de la gestion de la relation client (CRM), du commerce électronique, des données et de la marque, vous serez responsable de la stratégie de croissance client de votre marque — en identifiant les clientèles, les moments, les parcours et les leviers commerciaux qui peuvent réellement faire progresser les résultats.  C’est un rôle où il faut bâtir, faire évoluer les façons de faire et agir comme moteur de changement. Vous aurez l’occasion de remettre en question l’existant, de créer de nouvelles approches et de contribuer directement à la transformation de l’engagement client chez RCL.  Votre mandat : trouver les occasions de croissance. Bâtir la stratégie. Tester. Apprendre. Accélérer ce qui fonctionne.  Bâtir la stratégie de croissance    Piloter la croissance client à travers l’acquisition, l’engagement, la fidélisation et la réactivation.  Transformer la connaissance client et les priorités commerciales en stratégies qui génèrent du trafic, de la conversion et des revenus.  Identifier de nouvelles clientèles, de nouveaux comportements et des occasions de croissance additionnelle.     Réinventer le parcours client    Développer des stratégies de cycle de vie plus intelligentes à travers le courriel, le SMS, les programmes de fidélisation et les nouveaux canaux.  Faire évoluer la segmentation, le ciblage et la personnalisation vers des expériences de plus en plus individualisées, à grande échelle.  Travailler avec les équipes CRM pour transformer la stratégie en parcours clients performants, pertinents et continus.     Transfor

description: Als führendes Handelsunternehmen transformiert OBI den DIY-Sektor. Unser Bereich Digital Platform schafft die Grundlage für ein nahtloses Omnichannel-Erlebnis. Im Zentrum steht unsere Abteilung Customer Management, deren Aufgabe es ist, unsere Kund:innen über alle Touchpoints hinweg in ihren Projekten und Kundenphasen zu begleiten und so den Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) strategisch zu optimieren.  Zur erfolgreichen, internationalen Umsetzung dieser Wachstumsstrategie suchen wir Dich als Customer Lifecycle Manager in unserem Team. Als Designer der Customer Journey entwickelst du das Gerüst für unsere internationalen CRM-Aktivitäten. Du überführst Kundenbedürfnisse vom Onboarding bis zum komplexen Projekt in Erlebnisse, die nachhaltige Kundenbindung schaffen. Deine Mission ist die strategische Steigerung des Customer Lifetime Values durch skalierbare, internationale Blueprints.  Deine Mission: Strategie, Steuerung & Skalierung    Deine Aufgaben:    Strategieentwicklung : Identifikation der wesentlichen Treiber zur Steigerung des Customer Lifetime Values sowie Ableitung strategischer Anforderungen   Journey Design : Definition zentraler Kunden-Journeys und Entwurf skalierbarer Blueprints zur Optimierung für unsere internationalen Märkte   Stakeholdermanagement : Integration von Anforderungen, Überzeugung von Schnittstellen sowie Steuerung der cross-funktionalen Umsetzung   Performance -Analyse: Definition von Erfolgskennzahlen und datenbasierte Ableitung von Optimierungen zur nachhaltigen Steigerung der Kundenbindung   Problemlösung : Entwicklung kreativer Lösungswege bei Zielkonflikten zur Sicherstellung einer optimalen Customer Experience   Innovationsfokus : Bewertung und Skalierung neuer Ansätze wie AI-gestützter Content-Erstellung oder RPA-Lösungen zur Vertiefung der Personalisierung     Dein Profil:    Berufserfahrung : Mehrjährige einschlägige Praxis im CRM/Loyalty Management, digitalen Marketing oder Experience Design, idealerweise im internationalen Handel    Fachkenntnisse : Fundierte Expertise in der Entwicklung datengestützter CLV-Strategien und analytischer Tiefgang    Methodenkompetenz : Sicherer Umgang mit Customer Journey Mapping sowie Kenntnisse moderner CRM-Trends wie Predictive CRM oder GenAI    Projektmanagement : Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung internationaler Projekte unter Anwendung gängiger PM-Methoden    Kommunikationsstärke : Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht für technische Briefings oder Management-Präsentationen aufzubereiten    Persönlichkeit : Umsetzungsstarke Charakterstärke mit verhandlungssicheren Englischkenntnissen und einer hohen Lösungsorientierung    Ausbildung : Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des (Wirtschafts-) Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation     Unsere Vorteile für dich:     Work-Life-Balance  - title: Commercial Customer Success Manager
description: Wij zoeken een Customer Success Manager met een commerciële achtergrond, bij voorkeur in new business of account sales. Je werkt met bestaande klanten en stuurt op meetbaar gebruik en retentie.       Over ons   Vastgoeddata levert data en analyses over Nederlands commercieel vastgoed. Onze klanten zijn onder meer beleggers, taxateurs, banken, gemeenten, makelaars en adviseurs. Zij gebruiken ons platform voor snellere en beter onderbouwde beslissingen. We zijn een compact team: je hebt korte lijnen en merkt het effect van je werk direct.      De functie   Je beheert een portfolio bestaande klanten. Je verantwoordelijkheid is dat zij het product actief gebruiken en dat contracten worden verlengd. Je werft geen nieuwe logos; je werkt wel met dezelfde commerciële discipline als in sales: cijfers, planning en opvolging. Je onderhoudt een professionele samenwerking met je accounts. Het resultaat van de rol is gebruik en retentie, niet de relatie zelf.   Je volgt per account het gebruik: actieve gebruikers, frequentie en breedte van de inzet.  Je stelt per klant een plan op: welke gebruikers en welke toepassingen moeten landen, en welke actie daarop volgt.  Je neemt gebruikers mee door het product, gekoppeld aan hun use case, en spreekt een concrete volgende stap af.  Je begeleidt adoptie na onboarding en bij stilvallend gebruik, met een duidelijk resultaat binnen 30, 60 en 90 dagen.  Je signaleert retentierisico’s tijdig, bijvoorbeeld dalend gebruik of het wegvallen van een interne eigenaar, en pakt dat gestructureerd op.  Uitbreiding van het contract (extra gebruikers of modules) volgt uit aantoonbaar gebruik.  Je beantwoordt vragen van je accounts en helpt hen verder in het platform. Dat hoort bij het eigenaarschap van je portfolio. Je lost het vraagstuk op en vertaalt terugkerende signalen naar adoptie.  Je stemt af met Sales en Product over wat retentie of gebruik in de weg staat.       Resultaatgebieden    Retentie / churn in je portfolio  Productgebruik (actieve gebruikers, frequentie, breedte)  Voorspelbaarheid van je portfolio: welke accounts op koers liggen en welke actie nodig is  Expansie waar productgebruik dat onderbouwt       Profiel    Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in new business, account sales of commercial accountmanagement, bij voorkeur in SaaS of een ander model met terugkerende omzet.  Je kunt je resultaten in cijfers toelichten: target, realisatie en wat je aanpaste als het tegenviel.  Je werkt vanzelfsprekend met CRM en rapportages (Salesforce, Hubspot of vergelijkbaar).  Je blijft bij een account tot adoptie landt: volgende stap, moment, en controle of het gebruik er is. Je laat het niet bij contact.  Je werkt nauwkeurig, ook als het om klantdata en administratie in je portfolio gaat.  Je kunt zelfstandig klantvragen afhandelen en schakelt snel, zonder de sturing op je portfolio te laten verslappen.  Kennis van hoe vastgoedprofessionals data gebruiken is een pré, geen vereiste. description: Company Overview   At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.   Aperçu de l’entreprise   Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.   Department Overview   Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of mission critical digital mobile communication systems for Government & Public Safety Communications customers.  Motorola Solutions est un leader mondial dans le domaine des systèmes de communications mobiles professionnels avec un héritage impressionnant d'innovations technologiques et une base mondiale de systèmes mis en place. L'activité principale du groupe est la mise en œuvre de systèmes de communication mobile numérique critiques pour les clients du Gouvernement et de la Sécurité Publique. description: À propos de Workleap  Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.  Ton rôle  La croissance des revenus générés par nos clients existants s’accélère, et nos comptes les plus complexes ont besoin d’une personne d’expérience capable de prendre en charge des enjeux de cette envergure. À titre de Gestionnaire de comptes stratégiques senior, tu seras responsable d’un portefeuille composé de moyennes et grandes entreprises utilisant la plateforme Workleap. Ton rôle sera de protéger les revenus, de favoriser la croissance des comptes et d’agir comme un véritable partenaire stratégique auprès de nos clients.  Ce poste s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une migration tarifaire actuellement en cours à l’échelle de l’ensemble de notre portefeuille. title: Account Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 아임웹을 핵심 도구로 사용하고 있는 고객사들이 우리의 파트너입니다. Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다.    [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 Account Manager, Customer Success, 고객 컨설팅 등 고객 접점 직무에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  다수의 중, 대형 고객 포트폴리오를 운영하며 매출 성장과 리텐션, 업셀링에서 의미 있는 성과를 만들어내신 분  고객사의 비즈니스를 깊이 이해하고, 데이터를 기반으로 컨설팅에 가까운 제안을 해보신 분  Spreadsheet, BI 툴 등으로 직접 데이터를 분석하고, 협상과 제안의 근거로 활용하시는 분  고객사 의사결정자와 신뢰감 있게 소통하고, 다양한 이해관계자와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에 유연하게 적응하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM, 광고 솔루션 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험이 있으신 분  신규 영업의 협상과 계약부터 온보딩, 확장까지 풀 사이클을 경험해보신 분  CRM 또는 BI 툴을 적극적으로 활용해본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반의 업셀링, 크로스셀링 시나리오를 직접 설계해 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분  중형과 대형 고객사를 대상으로 한 정기 비즈니스 리뷰와 컨설팅 운영 경험  활용 데이터를 기반으로 이탈을 예측하거나 확장 기회를 발견해본 경험  D2C 브랜드, 쇼핑몰, 마켓플레이스 등 이커머스 생태계에 대한 깊은 이해       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

As part of George Weston Foods Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Associated British Foods plc, Baking Division NZ is a people, quality, customer, and consumer focused FMCG, employing over 500 people across New Zealand and at our 3 manufacturing sites.      About the Role:   We are looking for a  Key Account Manager - Woolworths  who is full of energy and passion and has an eye for opportunities to come join our awesome team. Come in and take charge of the strategic direction and implementation of one of our most important customers.  This is a role for someone who loves to define the direction in an account and then roll up their sleeves and get stuck in. The role will see you take ownership of your career development as you further build your negotiation, leadership, and project management skills. You will join a passionate and supportive team of ambitious and committed individuals, and we need our new team member to bring the same mindset.      This career move will see you:    Building deep and rich customer relationships at multiple levels within Woolworths  Developing, selling and implementing Business Plans  Negotiating deals to deliver the annual sales budget  Planning and executing the promotional program  Working closely with the field sales team to drive first class execution in store  Championing growth for your customer       The successful candidate is going to be:     An experienced Salesperson or Retail buyer ideally from within the FMCG sector  A strong relationship manager, negotiator, and influencer with both internal and external customers  A commercially astute, analytical individual with experience in financial management  A true leader with the ambition to deliver results and lead by our company values – safety, collaboration, courage, and trust.  Someone able to provide insight into a progressive career to date and a drive to grow further.       So, why join us? Its three core brands – Giorgio Armani, Emporio Armani and A|X Armani Exchange – are active in all the world’s major countries, across many continents. With origins firmly rooted in Italy, but also with a cosmopolitan vision and culture, the company has grown since it was founded in 1975, expanding its offer from clothes and accessories to cosmetics, fragrances, eyewear, watches, jewellery, and furniture and furnishing accessories. Today, therefore, as well as being well known in the area of fashion, the Armani Group is also renowned in the sectors of interior design, food and beverage, and hotels and resorts.  Giorgio Armani has created a style that has, with remarkable consistency, continued to explore countless variations and possibilities over the years. Convinced that ethics and aesthetics must coincide, Giorgio Armani expresses fundamental and enduring values through style. He does so by creating timeless pieces that, enhanced by precious materials and artisanal craftwork, resist the whim of fleeting trends with their pure and essential design.       Context and purpose of the job    Within our Emporio Armani flagship store in Milan, the Client Experience Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that daily store operations translate into a seamless, elevated client journey that is fully aligned with the brand’s core values, heritage, and identity. title: Service manager

title: Kreativ och affärsdriven Facility Manager/Key Account Manager till ISS
description: ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning till teknisk service, mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. Vi skapar arbetsplatser där människor trivs, företag växer och där hållbarhet är en självklarhet – socialt, miljömässigt och affärsmässigt. Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör – och avgörande för att våra kunder ska känna sig trygga, sedda – och för att deras arbetsplatser ska blomstra.      Vill du vara med och forma framtidens arbetsplatser?      Brinner du för service i världsklass, starka kundrelationer och ledarskap som gör skillnad? Ser du möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar och drivs av att utveckla både människor och affärer? Då kan detta vara din nästa utmaning!     Vi söker en affärsdriven och engagerad Facility Manager/Key Account Manager till vårt affärsområde  Office Based . Här får du möjlighet att leda några av våra viktigaste kundrelationer och tillsammans med kunden utveckla framtidens arbetsplatser och kontorsupplevelser.    För oss handlar kontoret om mer än en fysisk plats. Det är en miljö som ska främja kultur, samarbete, innovation och trivsel. Tillsammans med våra kunder skapar vi arbetsplatser där människor vill vara, presterar som bäst och känner sig välkomna varje dag.     Om rollen     Som Key Account Manager har du ett helhetsansvar för kundrelation, tjänsteleverans, ekonomi och utveckling. Du leder ett team av Service Managers och säkerställer att leveransen håller hög kvalitet samtidigt som du identifierar nya möjligheter att utveckla affären.    Du är en strategisk partner till kunden men också en närvarande ledare som trivs nära den dagliga verksamheten. Du förstår att goda resultat skapas genom engagerade medarbetare, stark teamwork och en leverans som överträffar kundens förväntningar.    Placeringsort är Stockholm.    Tjänsten är 100% tillsvidareanställning, med en inledande provanställning på 6 månader.      Ditt ansvar    Utveckla och stärka långsiktiga kundrelationer  Ansvara för budget, resultat och tillväxt  Säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveransen och kundupplevelsen  Identifiera och driva nya affärsmöjligheter  Leda, coacha och utveckla Service Managers och medarbetare  Driva förbättrings- och förändringsarbete  Bidra till att utveckla framtidens arbetsplats- och servicekoncept    Vem söker vi?     Du älskar service och människor och har ett starkt kommersiellt driv. Kanske kommer du från hotell- och hospitalitybranschen, facility management, retail eller annan tjänsteintensiv verksamhet där kundupplevelse, ledarskap och affärsmässighet varit en naturlig del av vardagen.    Du är lika bekväm i kundens ledningsgrupp som ute i verksamheten där servicen levereras. Du är en person som skapar förtroende, bygger relationer och får människor att växa.    För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:   Erfarenhet av ledarskap och verksamhet

title: Service Delivery Manager (w/m/d)
description: Pensum 80-100%   Als eigenständige Tochter der Axpo Gruppe ist die Axpo Systems AG das Kompetenzzentrum für Telekommunikations-, Cyber Security sowie Datacenter Lösungen im Konzern.  Unsere Kunden haben einen systemrelevanten Auftrag und befinden sich im Segment der kritischen Infrastrukturen. Sie kennen nur den höchstmöglichen Anspruch, denn sie betreiben die systemrelevanten Dienste der Schweiz. Das definiert den Anspruch an Profession, Zuverlässigkeit, Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards und die technische Lösungskompetenz an uns kompromisslos hoch – denn unsere Leistung ermöglicht erst die krisensichere Ausführung dieser unverzichtbaren Dienste.  Als Service Delivery Manager übernimmst du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für unsere Connectivity- und Datacenter-Services. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese kritischen Infrastruktur-Dienstleistungen reibungslos, kundenorientiert und in höchster Qualität erbracht werden. Dabei fungierst du als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Betrieb, Engineering und Management – und schaffst die Strukturen für operative Exzellenz.   Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten     Du gewährleistest die Einhaltung aller Service Level Agreements (SLAs) für Connectivity- und Datacenter-Services, überwachst KPIs und koordinierst das operative Tagesgeschäft nach ITIL  Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Kundenanliegen – von Onboarding über Betrieb bis zur Eskalation – und sorgst für Vertrauen, Transparenz und Verlässlichkeit  Du entwickelst und steuerst standardisierte Onboarding-Prozesse für neue Kunden unter Berücksichtigung technischer, organisatorischer und vertraglicher Aspekte  Du etablierst regelmässige Service-Review-Meetings, führst Risk Logs und erstellst aussagekräftige Reports für Management und Kundschaft  Du arbeitest eng mit internen Fachbereichen wie Network Engineering, Security, Datacenter- und Network Operation sowie Sales/KAM zusammen  Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen, Tools und Technik und treibst Operational-Excellence-Initiativen voran      Profil und Fähigkeiten     Du hast Erfahrung als Service Delivery Manager, Service Owner oder Projektleiter im Bereich IT-Infrastruktur – idealerweise mit Fokus auf Netzwerk- und Datacenter-Services  Du bringst ein fundiertes technisches Verständnis von Connectivity-Lösungen (WAN/LAN, Routing, Switching, Security) und Datacenter-Technologien mit  Erfahrung mit Datacenter-Operations, Connectivity und hybriden Infrastrukturen ist von Vorteil  Du bist vertraut mit ITIL, SLA-Strukturen, KPI-Messung und Service-Governance – oder bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich hier einzuarbeiten  Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Kundenmanagement-Skills sowie eine strukturierte, pragmatische und belastbare Persönlichkeit  Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

description: Tigloo sigue creciendo en Pamplona, por ello la Directora de Outsourcing ha decidido crear una nueva vacante de Service Delivery Manager para ayudarle a abarcar las diversas tareas que requiere gestionar esta gran línea de la empresa. Fanatical devotion to customer service, business quality, and data security.  Thinks out-of-the-box and energizes others with passion, quality, and commitment. Field sales experience strongly desired      Preferred Qualifications      Environment and Physical Demands  Work is primarily sedentary in nature and can be executed sitting or standing positions in an office environment.  Requires ability to utilize technology related to using a keyboard, verbal communication, and work with device screens which require visual acuity.   If located in a company office, often requires the mobility to physically navigate the space. There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

title: UI Designer - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

  • Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

  • Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows

title: Manufacturing Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engin

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

title: Senior Content and Social Media Manager
description:
🚀 About Nivoda

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

🤔 About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Content and Social Media Manager to own our social channels and be the creative engine behind our marketing campaigns. You are a storyteller first and an operator second: you can take an idea, shape it into something people actually want to watch and share, and make it show up consistently everywhere we publish.

This is a connective role. You will own the content calendar, plan and run campaigns end to end, keep a strong and consistent presence on social, and run our newsletter. You will be the glue across marketing, making sure a campaign lands as one coherent story across social, email, and beyond rather than a set of disconnected posts. As the team grows we will add editorial depth alongside you (long-form writing and podcast production), so you can stay focused on what you do best: social, storytelling, and campaigns that move.

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

You are also the technical point of contact for your customers. Enterprise conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful without a Solutions Engineer in the room. description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?

Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.

  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

Account Management Team

The Account Management team is the link between Zefir and the network of partner real estate agents who sell our clients' homes. The team finds them, trains them, and makes them perform.

As an Account Manager Junior, you own the first half of that journey: you map your market, you find and qualify the agents, and you get them ready. Once an agent is trained and running, you hand them over to an Account Manager, who takes the long-term relationship from there.

This is the entry point into the Account Management team, and the role is built as a training ground. The natural next step is Account Manager.

 

Responsibilities

  • Map your local market and identify the agents worth approaching.

  • Source and qualify agents against Zefir's standards.

  • Assign signed mandates to the most relevant qualified agents.

  • Onboard and train new agents until they are autonomous on their first seller appointment.

  • Hand trained agents over to the Account Management team, and follow through on the handover.

  • Trigger and manage agent replacements

The transition to a sustainable future requires discovering new mineral resources to power clean technologies and renewable energy solutions. From lithium for electric vehicle batteries, to copper for wind turbines, and rare earth elements for electronics, these minerals are the building blocks of our energy transition.

Lithosquare radically speeds up mineral exploration by combining foundational AI, geological expertise, and real-world data to reduce uncertainty, prioritize the right targets, reduce costs and accelerate discovery. About the job

As a Geologist at Lithosquare, you will play a key hybrid role at the intersection of field operation (around 20%) and office work (80%). You will support field campaign execution while actively contributing to data compilation, targeting, and QA/QC across our exploration portfolio.

title: Freelancer Technical Recruiter
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

title: AMI Scientist/Interns - Geometry and 3D Vision
description:
About AMI

We are building a new breed of AI systems that (1) understand the real world, (2) have persistent memory, (3) can reason and plan, and (4) are controllable and safe.

We are a team of scientists and engineers building frontier world model-based AI. We combine the scientific rigor of a top-tier research institute with focus on engineering excellence and execution.

We are a global company, with offices in Paris, Montreal, New York, and Singapore. Come build the future of AI with us!

About this Role

AMI believes AI agents should predict and plan using an internal model of the world — their world model. We’re looking for new team members to advance the state-of-the-art in world modeling. We believe that video is a rich and abundant source of data reflecting how the world works, and that in general models need to be able to process continuous, high-dimensional data from a variety of sensors to: (a) understand context about the current state of the physical world, (b) make predictions about how the world will evolve, possibly as a result of actions taken, and (c) plan and adapt sequences of actions to complete complex tasks, possibly in dynamic, complex environments.

 

You will work with a team on world model research efforts, with a specific focus on 3D geometry of the real world, including::

  • Self-supervised learning methods to efficiently learn from video and other continuous, high-dimensional signals

  • New architectures that efficiently learn to predict world dynamics from video and other high-dimensional signals

  • Scalable algorithms for pre-processing and curating video data

About Blue Earth Capital

Blue Earth Capital is a global, independent specialist impact investment firm headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with team members based in London, New York, Madrid and Konstanz. With approximately USD 1.9 billion in assets under management, we invest across Private Equity, Private Credit and Private Equity Partnerships, seeking measurable environmental and social impact alongside attractive, market-rate financial returns. BlueEarth is owned by the Blue Earth Foundation, a Swiss charitable foundation that uses the firm’s profits to support philanthropic initiatives.

Help grow our investor base across DACH, Nordic and Benelux markets. title: Team Lead Procurement & Supply Chain
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scale-up with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 9 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

As Team Lead Procurement/Supply Chain, you will lead a team of four - two Procurement/Supply Chain Experts and two Export Experts - and own the full procurement cycle: from supplier selection and contract negotiation through auditing and serial production management.

On the Procurement/Supply Chain side, you will manage a defined supplier panel covering hard goods (electronics, plastics, packaging materials, and commodities), as well as licenses and software. You will define procurement policies in alignment with our overall operations strategy and deploy them across our supplier base, working closely with New Product Introduction projects and our production team.

On the Export side, you will ensure that inbound and outbound logistics are tightly aligned with customer demand and production needs. You will keep costs within target range, and take ownership of tracking and reporting our service level and stock performance.

You will work cross-functionally with Production, Finance, Industrialization, and R&D - and play a direct role in shaping how we scale our operations.

  • Assist with component selection and trade-offs by turning test data into clear comparisons.
  • Reduce and analyse test data in MATLAB and Python — efficiency, thrust, endurance, thermal and discharge behaviour.
  • Visualise results so the engineering team can make decisions from them quickly.
  • Keep test setups, measurements, and finding

Partner Marketing Specialist / Manager - Mercari Shops (BtoC領域新規事業)     雇用形態： 正社員  働き方： フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし）   勤務地： 六本木     詳細はキャリアサイトの募集要項よりご確認ください   メルカリグループについて    あらゆる価値を循環させ、あらゆる人の可能性を広げる   「地球資源が限られているなか、より豊かな社会をつくるために何ができるか」。2013年、創業者の山田進太郎が世界一周の旅で抱いた課題意識から、フリマアプリ「メルカリ」は生まれました。私たちは、物理的なモノやお金に限らずあらゆる価値を循環させることで、誰もがやりたいことを実現し、人や社会に貢献するための選択肢を増やすことができると信じています。  テクノロジーの力で世界中の人々をつなぎ、あらゆる人の可能性が発揮される世界を実現していきます。メルカリグループの目指すべき方針については Mercari Culture Doc をご覧ください。   組織・チームのミッション      Eコマース市場において、メルカリShopsが提供する独自の価値。それは「月間2,400万人以上が日々モノを探し、売買を楽しむ『熱量の高い市場』に、最初からショップを開設できる」という点です。一般的なネットショップで最初の壁となりやすい「集客」のハードルを下げ、出品した瞬間からメルカリの巨大な顧客基盤へ直接リーチできるーーこれは、独自のプラットフォーム基盤を持つメルカリだからこそ提供できるユニークな強みです。  Partner Marketingチームのミッションは、このプラットフォームの強みを活かし、出店ショップさまの「持続的な事業成長」を実現することです。単にショップを開設してもらうだけでなく、メルカリのデータや各種チャネル（CRM、セミナー、カンファレンス等）を駆使し、ショップさまがファンを獲得し、長期的な売上基盤を築くために伴走します。  フリマアプリとしては国内最大級のメルカリですが、BtoC EC領域においてはまだ「チャレンジャー」です。本ポジションでは、この巨大なアセットを活用しながら、これまでにない大胆な戦略を仕掛け、メルカリShopsを日本のEC市場の次なる柱へと引き上げていく役割を担っていただきます。「複雑な環境下で新しい事業の勝ち筋を創る」という、他では味わえない手触り感とダイナミズムを共に楽しんでいただける仲間を募集しています。     ※メルカリのミッション・バリューについての詳細はこちらをご覧ください   業務内容   メルカリShopsにおいて、出店ショップさまの成功と事業成長を牽引するリテンションマーケティング戦略の立案および施策の実行をリードしていただきます。 既存の手法にとらわれず、メルカリが持つ月間約2,400万人規模の顧客接点やデータを活用し、ショップさまの売上最大化とエンゲージメント向上に直結する施策をハンズオンで推進していただく重要なポジションです。    【マルチチャネル戦略の設計・実行】 CRM、オンラインセミナー、オフラインカンファレンス、郵送DMなど、オンライン/オフラインを問わず最適なチャネルを組み合わせたコミュニケーション戦略の設計、および施策の最適化・KPIマネジメント。  【サクセスコンテンツの企画・推進】 「メルカリShops売上UPノウハウ」など、出店ショップさまが自走し、売上を最大化するための各種コンテンツ（記事、動画、マニュアル等）の企画、制作ディレクション、および配信推進。  【リテンション強化に向けた新規施策の立案・推進】 既存の枠組みにとらわれない、リテンションマーケティング全般における新規施策の企画・検証（PoC）・実行。  【全体戦略設計・KPIマネジメント（Managerポジション）】 メルカリShops出店ショップさまに向けたリテンションマーケティング全体の戦略立案およびKPI策定・マネジメント。事業目標から逆算したロードマップを描き、チームの実行を牽引していただきます。      ユニークなチャレンジ     大規模な基盤を活かし、新たなビジネス領域を拡張する醍醐味：   フリマアプリとしては日本最大級のプラットフォームであるメルカリも、B2CのECプラットフォームとしてはチャレンジャーとなります。チャレンジャーとして、自ら大胆な施策を考え、それを推進できる環境があります。決まった施策をマニュアル通りに運用するといった業務に留まらず、自ら考えた戦略やアイディアを月間約2400万人以上が利用するプラットフォームの中で形にし、推進することができます   社内外を巻き込み、自ら戦略を描き推進できる環境：   大きなプラットフォームで1つの企画・施策を形にしていくためには、社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込み、交渉、折衝を丁寧に重ねながら、ベストなアウトプットにするため、強いオーナーシップとチームワーク醸成が求められます。ありたい姿、強いwillを常に持ち、それを周囲に伝え、理解、共感を得て、前進させていく、という強い意欲と高いコミュニケーション力を持った方に適した環境です。   AI活用とデータ連携により、本質的な「売れる仕組み」を一気通貫で推進： description: Job Description    楽天・事業について   楽天グループは、国内外において、Eコマース、トラベル、デジタルコンテンツなどのインターネットサービス、クレジットカードをはじめ、銀行、証券、電子マネー、スマホアプリ決済といったフィンテック（金融）サービス、携帯キャリア事業などのモバイルサービス、さらにプロスポーツといった多岐にわたる分野で70以上のサービスを提供しています。  これらサービスを、楽天会員を中心としたメンバーシップを軸に有機的に結び付けることで、他にはない独自の「楽天エコシステム（経済圏）」を形成しています。   部署・サービスについて   コマース＆マーケティングカンパニーでは、「イノベーションを通じて、人々と社会をエンパワーメントする」という楽天グループのミッションのもと、楽天市場、楽天トラベル、楽天ブックス、Rakuten Fashion、楽天24、楽天マート、各種メディア系サービスなど、楽天グループの中核を担う幅広いサービスを展開しています。  当部では、Commerce Companyにおける各事業／サービスのCS業務を統括管理・運営しています。  各単一CSの運営・品質を向上するとともに、全CSを横断的に管理・改善することで、CS全体の効率化・サービス向上を最大化しています。  また、楽天グループのさまざまなサービスをご利用いただくお客様の、多種多様なニーズ・課題を、蓄積された応対ログやVOC（Voice Of Customer）から分析し提言していくことで、各サービス・事業の改善活動の推進、事業貢献・成長に寄与しています。   ポジション：    募集背景   さらなる事業成長、コマース領域における流通規模拡大を目指し、CS業務改革による生産性・品質の向上はもとより、サービス・事業における顧客思考の強化、クロスユース等、Commerce領域の横断的なサービス利用拡大を実現するため、大規模なAI導入の推進とともに、顧客課題・ニーズの分析・改善推進の強化が求められています。  そのため、AI戦略を立案・推進するとともに、VOC起点での事業・サービス貢献を、戦略的に担える戦略策定・VOCアナリスト担当を募集します。  楽天グループの多様なサービスを支えるカスタマーサポート・事業改善領域において、データと顧客の声を活かし、次世代のサービス体験を一緒に創っていきませんか。  ＜魅力＞  本ポジションでは、楽天グループの中核サービスを支えるカスタマーサポート・事業改善領域において、以下のような経験を積むことができます。  単なる分析業務にとどまらず、楽天グループの膨大な『顧客の声』を資産化し、AIと共にサービスを進化させる取り組みに従事できます。  ・楽天市場・楽天トラベルなど大規模サービスの顧客窓口のAI導入による自動化/効率化の実現  ・VOCを起点にした事業改善・戦略策定への関与  ・マーケティング・開発・CS等、複数部署と連携したクロスファンクショナルな業務推進  ・生成AI・データ分析ツールを活用した次世代VOC分析手法の開発   業務内容   楽天グループのコマース＆マーケティングカンパニーが管掌する各種サービスに対して、横断的に以下の業務を担当いただきます。  ＜業務対象＞  ■コマースカンパニー配下の各種事業・サービスにおけるAI化戦略策定・活動推進  ・Gen-AIを用いた、自動応対強化（AI BOT施策）  ・Gen-AIを用いた、CSスタッフの応対効率化（AI CSサポート施策）  ■コマースカンパニー配下の各種事業・サービスにおけるVOC分析・戦略策定  ・VOC分析・レポーティング  ・事業・サービス課題の見える化  ・改善活動の立案・提示  ・関係各部署（マーケティング、開発、CS等）を交えた活動推進  ＜具体的な業務内容＞  ・各種AIソリューションの導入計画立案・PJT推進/実行  ・開発部門との自社AIツール、AIシステムの構築計画/設計・実装・導入  ・VOCログ（CS応対ログ等）からのAI定量分析・定性分析  ・社内各種データとのクロス分析  ・定期レポート資料作成・各種報告会でのレポーティング  ・事業・サービスの既存課題整理、対策案の提示  ・関係各部署との活動調整  ・改善効果分析   働く環境   ＜組織構成＞  社員約10名（うちAI推進プロジェクト担当8名、VOC分析担当2名）  その他、外部業務委託・パートナースタッフが在籍しています。  ＜既存メンバーのバックグラウンド＞  CS運営・データ分析・マーケティング等の経験者がおります。  ＜キャリアパス例＞  CSAI化プロジェクト推進担当として経験の幅を広げる他、VOC分析担当から戦略策定リーダー、さらには部門マネージャーへのキャリアアップも可能です。   必須要件：   ・現場オペレーションの改善活動、BPR経験  ・顧客ニーズ・課題の分析経験（業界不問）  ・データ分析・レポーティング経験  ・定量・定性分析を活用した課題解決経験   歓迎要件：   ・VOC分析・改善提案の実務経験  ・マーケティング領域におけるユーザ分析経験  ・生成AI・チャットボット等を活用した業務改善経験  ・インターネット・EC・旅行・エンタメ業界での業務経験  ・カスタマーサポート品質改善・業務改善の推進経験  ・プロジェクトマネジメント経験  ＜求める人物像＞  ・データと顧客の声を起点に、課題を自ら見つけ改善を推進できる方  ・関係部署と連携しながら、粘り強く改善活動を推進できる方  ・変化を楽しみ、新しい技術・手法への学習意欲がある方  ・チームで成果を出すことにやりがいを感じる方   その他：    勤務地に関する補足   楽天クリムゾンハウス  東京都世田谷区玉川1-14-1   英語要件に関する補足   TOEIC 800点以上（もしくは同程度の英語力を保有している資格の証明、英語圏の大卒以上の学位証明ができること）  内定通知のタイミングまでには資格の証明が必要です。 At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time.
