title: Junior Customer Success Manager - Small Business
description: Notre mission   L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent.  Fondée à Paris en 2019, Modjo est en train de devenir le leader européen de l'IA appliquée à la vente.  Les équipes commerciales ont accès à plus de données que jamais, mais celles-ci sont dispersées entre les CRM, les e-mails, les outils de vente et les échanges avec les clients. Lorsque le contexte est fragmenté, des signaux essentiels se perdent, les pipelines ralentissent et les opportunités s'envolent.  Chez Modjo, nous développons un système d’agents IA qui comprend le contexte de chaque compte, de chaque opportunité et de chaque équipe. Nos agents aident les commerciaux à préparer leurs réunions, à gérer les objections, à exploiter pleinement les opportunités, à hiérarchiser les actions pertinentes et à faire avancer les dossiers.  Le défi n’est pas de créer un énième outil. Il s’agit de développer une IA suffisamment fiable et utile pour devenir un véritable coéquipier des équipes commerciales.  Avec une solution développée en France et des données hébergées en Europe, Modjo construit une alternative européenne souveraine en matière d’IA appliquée à la vente.  Rejoindre Modjo, c’est contribuer à redéfinir la manière dont des millions de commerciaux travailleront demain.    Pourquoi on recrute ?    Nous recherchons un ou une  Customer Success Manager 1 to Many  pour accompagner la réussite, l'adoption, la rétention et la croissance d'un portefeuille important de clients B2B grâce à une approche one-to-many scalable.  Il s'agit d'un rôle  structurant et à fort impact  : tu rejoindras l'équipe à un moment clé du développement de notre modèle de Customer Success à grande échelle et tu auras la responsabilité de l'expérience client d'environ 200 comptes.    Tes missions       Piloter l'onboarding et l'adoption à grande échelle  Onboarder les nouveaux clients à travers des kick-offs collectifs, des sessions de groupe, des webinars et un suivi structuré.  Aider les clients à identifier les cas d'usage pertinents et à tirer de la valeur des fonctionnalités clés de Modjo, notamment de ses fonctionnalités d'IA.  Identifier les clients peu engagés et concevoir des plans d'activation ciblés pour augmenter l'utilisation et l'adoption.   Piloter la rétention et la croissance grâce à la data  Suivre l'utilisation du produit, la santé des clients, les échéances de renouvellement et les autres signaux d'un portefeuille d'environ 200 clients.  Détecter rapidement les risques de churn, les situations de downsell et les opportunités d'upsell, puis construire des plans d'action clairs.  Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Account Management, Sales, Support, Product et Marketing lorsqu'une situation client nécessite une action transverse.   Être la voix du client et un ambassadeur de l'IA  Transformer les retours clients, les questions produit et les problèmes récurrents en insight

description: Description   KOMOJUについて：  KOMOJU(コモジュ)は、世界最大級のゲームプラットフォーム「Steam」やECプラットフォーム「Shopify」にも採用されている、KOMOJUが提供するオールインワン決済サービスです。直感的に理解しやすい、シンプルかつ統一的なAPIを提供することで、KOMOJUを導入するだけでクレジットカード、コンビニ決済、各種電子マネー、銀行振込、ペイジーなど複数の決済方法の利用を可能にしています。KOMOJUは今後も、様々な金融機関、決済ネットワーク、銀行、各種ウォレットと緊密な連携を行うことで、多くの国や地域、通貨、および現地の各種決済方法を選択でき、確実かつ迅速に多くの決済取引の処理を実現可能なものとしていきます。  募集背景：  事業拡大に伴い、当社の決済プラットフォームを利用する加盟店数・業種の多様性が急速に拡大しています。これまで加盟店審査業務はカスタマーサクセス部の一機能として運用してきましたが、リスク管理・コンプライアンス要件の高度化、ならびに審査件数の増加を背景に、加盟店審査部を独立した組織として運用・強化を進めています。  本ポジションでは、加盟店審査部の マネージャー ※本ポジションはマネージャーとしての採用ですが、ご経験・ご志向、および入社後の実績や適性に応じて、将来的に加盟店審査部の責任者（Head）をお任せする可能性もあります。  選考の中でHeadとしての適性を確認できた場合、Headポジションでのオファーをご相談させていただくこともあります。  Responsibilities（期待する役割）： Seit über 14 Jahren entwickeln wir bei TenMedia Individualsoftware für Mittelstand, öffentliche Hand und KRITIS-Betreiber. Unsere Software läuft dort, wo Ausfälle keine Option sind: in Behörden, bei kritischen Infrastrukturen und im Mittelstand.

Wir suchen dich als erfahrenen PHP-Entwickler / Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d), der genau in diesen Projekten zu Hause sein will. Du entwickelst neue Anwendungen von A bis Z mit, übernimmst Verantwortung für laufende Systeme und bringst Legacy-Anwendungen auf aktuelle Stände. Weil wir betreiben, was wir bauen, endet deine Arbeit nicht mit dem Go-live: Du siehst über Jahre, was aus deinem Code wird, und echte Kunden nutzen ihn täglich. Die Stelle ist dabei auf Entwicklung angelegt, auch auf deine: Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, wächst bei uns zum Lead Developer, langfristig bis zur CTO-Rolle.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst abwechslungsreiche Individualsoftware
  • Du setzt REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Fachverfahren und Drittsystemen um
  • Du übernimmst langfristige Verantwortung für laufende Anwendungen: Updates, Sicherheits-Patches, Performance-Optimierung und Monitoring
  • Du arbeitest mit einem modernen Stack: Laravel, Livewire, MySQL, Redis, Docker, FrankenPHP und Caddy, Azure/AWS
  • Du arbeitest nach Scrum mit DevOps-Boards, machst Code Reviews im Team
  • Du stimmst dich direkt mit unseren langjährigen Kunden ab

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung, ein Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der PHP-Entwicklung
  • Wesentliche Beteiligung an mindestens zwei PHP-Softwareprojekten, die produktiv im Einsatz sind oder waren
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Laravel (Eloquent, Queues, Testing etc.)
  • Erfahrung mit mind. einem JavaScript-Framework

title: Business Development Director (DACH)
description:
About the Role 

Imagine this. You are the person German, Austrian and Swiss defence customers call first when they want to understand what is actually possible, and the person inside Destinus who turns that conversation into a funded programme. 

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. 

This role sits in the Future Capabilities organisation of Destinus Germany and reports to the Chief Future Capabilities Officer. You lead senior business development for the DACH region and open the doors that future capability programmes need in order to exist at all. 

You will build the DACH BD team. The measure of this role is the forces commitments that turn advanced technology into procurement-ready capability for the region. You work as one team across the company: with Commercial on pricing, contracting and pipeline, with Engineering on what is technically achievable.  

 

What You’ll Do 

  • Build and lead senior business development for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, covering armed forces, procurement authorities, security agencies and industrial partners. 
  • Open and hold senior access at BMVg, BAAINBw, Bundeswehr commands, national agencies and NATO bodies, in close coordination with Destinus government relations. 
  • Shape future demand: translate what customers and users actually need into requirements

title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
description:

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal pro

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.

The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without needing a college degree or prior experience.

Coaching with CourseCareers isn’t a traditional employee position — it’s a flexible, paid side opportunity within our coaching marketplace.   • 3+ years of industry experience.

  • Strong communication skills and interest in mentoring beginners.

  • U.S. residency.

  • Clear understanding of entry-level roles and how the industry works.

À propos de Panora

Panora est une plateforme d'IA native pour les courtiers en assurance. Nos agents IA automatisent les workflows à forte friction, cotation, comparaison de contrats, analyse des garanties, vérification de conformité, génération de documents et produisent des résultats structurés et actionnables en quelques minutes plutôt qu'en heures.

Nous accompagnons les cabinets de courtage en France et en Belgique, avec une conviction claire : le courtage en assurance est opérationnellement dysfonctionnel depuis des décennies, et l'IA est enfin le bon outil pour y remédier. L'IA n'est plus optionnelle pour les courtiers : elle devient le standard. La question n'est plus si, mais à quel point elle est bien mise en œuvre.

Panora a été fondée par Diane et Fabian. Diane a passé plusieurs années en capital-risque avec une solide expérience opérationnelle et connaît de l'intérieur les défis du scaling de business complexes. Fabian est un fondateur multi-récidiviste et ingénieur IA orienté produit, pionnier dans la construction de systèmes IA qui fonctionnent vraiment en production. Ensemble, ils ont décidé de créer Panora pour transformer les opérations d'assurance en avantage concurrentiel en temps réel pour les courtiers.

Panora est soutenue par Hexa (anciennement eFounders), le studio de startups pionnier en Europe, qui a lancé plus de 35 entreprises dont des licornes comme Front, Aircall et Spendesk.

Pourquoi ce rôle existe

Nous avons construit une IA qui lit des contrats, compare des garanties et génère des analyses de couverture à grande échelle. La technologie fonctionne. Nous avons maintenant besoin de quelqu'un qui la rende brillante : quelqu'un d'assez méticuleux pour détecter chaque lacune, d'assez expérimenté pour savoir ce qui compte vraime

Wir sorgen dafür, dass Energie nicht nur erzeugt, sondern optimal vermarktet und wirtschaftlich genutzt wird. Unterstützt durch unsere Plattform und Trading-Algorithmen schaffen wir maximale Transparenz, Effizienz und neue Erlösmodelle für unsere Kunden.   Bereits heute bewirtschaften wir über 350 MWp Solar, 100 MWp Wind, 100 MWh Speicher, 12 MW Wasserstoff und über 40 HPC-Ladestationen.    Wir:      stehen für intelligente Energieportfolios und langfristige Kundenpartnerschaften.   sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kunden wirtschaftlich erfolgreicher werden – nicht nur zufrieden sind.   haben Spaß daran, neue Energieprodukte und Geschäftsmodelle zu entwickeln.   leben eine offene Feedbackkultur und treiben kontinuierliche Verbesserung voran.   legen Wert auf Geschwindigkeit, Ownership und echte Wirkung im Markt.         Aufgaben    Als  Energy Customer Success & Portfolio Growth Manager  verantwortest du die Entwicklung unserer Kunden und ihrer Energieportfolios. Du stellst sicher, dass aus einzelnen Anlagen skalierbare, wirtschaftlich erfolgreiche Hybridkraftwerke entstehen und entwickelst bestehende Kunden kontinuierlich weiter.    1. Schnelle Aktivierung neuer Kunden    85 % aller neuen Kunden starten innerhalb von 8 Wochen nach Vertragsabschluss aktiv in die Vermarktung ihrer Energieanlagen.    2. Wachstum im Bestandskundenportfolio    40 % der Bestandskunden erweitern ihr Energieportfolio jährlich durch zusätzliche Assets oder neue Energieprodukte.    3. Aufbau und Entwicklung von Energieportfolios    Mindestens 20 neue Assets (PV, Grünstromspeicher, HPC) werden pro Quartal in bestehende Kundenportfolios integriert.    4. Aktive Entwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen    Mindestens 10 strukturierte Portfolio-Reviews pro Monat mit Kunden zur Identifikation von Wachstums- und Optimierungspotenzialen.    5. Kontinuierliches Wachstum des Energieportfolios    Das aktiv vermarktete Kundenportfolio (MW) wächst kontinuierlich durch neue Anlagen, Speicher und Hybridkraftwerke.    Qualifikation     Du:      brennst dafür, Kunden nicht nur zu betreuen, sondern aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und ihre Energieportfolios auf das nächste Level zu bringen.   erkennst sofort, wo bei Kunden zusätzliche Potenziale liegen – ob durch neue Anlagen, Grünstromspeicher, Hybridkraftwerke oder optimierte Vermarktung.   bleibst fokussiert, auch wenn du mehrere Kunden, Projekte und neue Energieprodukte parallel entwickelst – für dich ist das genau die Herausforderung, die du suchst.   findest es spannend, Energieportfolios zu analysieren und daraus konkrete Wachstumsstrategien abzuleiten.   denkst nicht in Support-Tickets, sondern in  Wachstum, Erlösen und langfristigen Partnerschaften .   überzeugst mit deinem unternehmerischen Mindset und treibst Themen aktiv voran, statt auf Vorgaben zu warten.   gehst

description: Role Highlights   This is a rare opportunity for an experienced Customer Success leader to take ownership of a growing regional function within Powerfleet, a large-scale fleet management, telematics and IoT company that is already a major player in its space and continuing to grow at pace. The role will suit someone who enjoys building high-performing teams, driving customer value at scale, and acting as the strategic link between a fast-growing region and a global organisation. You will be accountable for the performance of a geographically distributed regional team, based across Perth, Adelaide and Brisbane, with the core function based in Perth, and for the experience, value and outcomes delivered to customers throughout their lifecycle.  You will lead, coach and develop the Customer Success Managers across the region, ensuring consistent standards and accountability across office-based and remote employees, and making sure they truly understand their customers' businesses, objectives, contractual commitments and measures of success. The role also provides the critical connection between APAC customers, regional leadership and the global Customer Success function. You will be representing regional priorities and insights while implementing global initiatives and driving consistent practices across the business. You will use customer feedback, NPS and portfolio insights to inform improvements, feed customer insight into Product, Support, Operations and Implementation, and give both regional and global leadership clear visibility of performance, risk and priorities. As the function continues to grow, you will also help shape appropriate team capacity, structure and ways of working for the future. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
description:
The question

Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. title: Director, Business Development
description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

title: (Senior) Operations Engineer - Charging Network (f/m/x)
description:
Your mission

IONITY is building the backbone of electric mobility in Europe. Founded by leading automotive manufacturers, we operate Europe's largest high-power charging network across 24 countries, enabling seamless long-distance travel for EV drivers. With thousands of charging points already in operation and significant expansion ahead, IONITY is evolving beyond charging infrastructure into a broader mobility, energy and digital platform. 

As a (Senior) Operations Engineer, you keep that network running. You're the technical backbone of our Operations team: analysing and resolving issues across chargers, backend systems and communication, steering the external partners who maintain our sites, and making sure our monitoring gives us a full picture of network health. When something goes wrong anywhere across our network, you're the person who works out why and makes sure it doesn't happen again. 

This is a hands-on technical role with real scope to shape how we operate at scale. As the network grows, so does the need for sharper processes, better tooling and knowledge that's shared rather than siloed, and you'll drive all three. 
  
Your responsibilities: 

  • Ensure high availability and quality of IONITY HPC network
  • Ensureeffficientoperationsprocesses

  • Provide learnings, insights and how to’s concerning troubleshooting of IONITY’s HPC Network towards the IONITY team and external support
  • Steering of external partners for operating IONITY's HPC Network
  • Ensure 360°-Monitoring of IONITY HPC Network (Backend-systems, Hardware & Communication)

Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

Getting it to actually work for a specific site, with its own trading patterns, staff and quirks, is another. That's what this role owns; working directly with customers to turn Sona's forecasting and scheduling tools into labour models that actually get used on site.

title: Senior AI Strategist (Barcelona - German Speaker)
description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

As a Senior AI Strategist (German Speaker), you are the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, helping the organization turn AI opportunities into successful, sustainable solutions. You will operate at the intersection of change management, stakeholder management, and AI delivery. You will work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Business stakeholders, IT, and senior leadership. While you won’t be expected to write code, you should be technically fluent enough to understand AI projects, challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and translate technical topics into clear business implications.

Welche Faktoren sind wichtig, damit sich Mitarbeiter in einer Steuerkanzlei wohlfühlen? Natürlich ein zufriedenstellendes Gehalt, aber sonst? Ein interessanter und abwechslungsreicher Mandantenkreis? Ein Arbeitsalltag, bei dem auch mal gemeinsam gelacht wird? Ein unkonventioneller, digitaler Arbeitsplatz, auch zum Wohlfühlen? Flexible Arbeitszeiten? Vielleicht gepaart mit der Möglichkeit zum regelmäßigen Homeoffice? Das Vertrauen des Chefs, welches diese Arbeitsmodelle überhaupt erst ermöglicht? Ein offenes, internationales Team? Freiwillige Zusatzleistungen?

Unser Mandant ist eine inhabergeführte Steuerbratungskanzlei Mitten in einem der schönsten Stadtteile Hamburgs. Die Mitarbeiter können auf einen großen Erfahrungsschatz zurückgreifen: Sowohl in Bezug auf unterschiedliche Branchen, Tätigkeiten und Unternehmensformen als auch in Bezug auf besonders komplexe Fälle, die eine fachliche Expertise bzw. praktische Kenntnisse der steuerlichen Besonderheiten einer expliziten Fragestellung in einem bestimmten Bereich erfordern. Mit fundierter Kompetenz bietet das Team eine ganzheitliche und kreative Steuerberatung – einschließlich der Vertretung vor Finanzämtern und anderen Behörden.

Aufgaben

  • Sie betreuen eigenverantwortlich Mandantinnen und Mandanten unterschiedlicher Größenordnungen und Branchen

title: Quality Assurance Specialist (m/w/d) E-Commerce Image Production
description:
Doopic ist ein Berliner Unternehmen für professionelle Bildbearbeitung und Content-Produktion im E-Commerce. Wir bearbeiten täglich große Mengen an Produkt- und Fashion-Content für namhafte nationale und internationale Kunden.

Dabei verbinden wir klassische Bildbearbeitung mit modernen, KI-gestützten Prozessen und arbeiten mit einem internationalen Netzwerk aus spezialisierten Grafikern und Produktionsteams.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir einen Quality Assurance Specialist (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung in der professionellen Bildbearbeitung und einem ausgeprägten Auge für Details.

Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Quality-Assurance-Teams stellst du sicher, dass unser Bild- und Contentmaterial den individuellen Anforderungen unserer Kunden entspricht. Dabei geht es nicht nur um die klassische Qualitätskontrolle: Unsere Produktionsprozesse entwickeln sich zunehmend in Richtung KI-gestützter Workflows, automatisierter Bildverarbeitung und neuer Content-Services.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

  • Qualitätskontrolle und Bewertung von professionell bearbeitetem Bildmaterial aus unserer laufenden Produktion
  • Prüfung der Ergebnisse anhand kundenspezifischer Vorgaben, Briefings und Qualitätsstandards
  • Sichtung und Vorauswahl von Bildmaterial für unsere Kunden - z. B. Auswahl geeigneter Motive aus größeren Bildmengen nach definierten Kriterien
  • Mitarbeit an KI-gestützten Workflows zur Bildauswahl, Bearbeitung und Veredelung von Content
  • Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung solcher Workflows im operativen Tagesgeschäft
  • Veredelung und Optimierung von Bildmaterial sowie Durchführung kleinerer Korrekturen und Anpassungen in Adobe Photoshop
  • Erkennen und Dokumentieren von Fehlern sowie Weitergabe von Korrekturanforderungen an unsere internationalen Produktionsteams und Freelancer
  • Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwick

title: Teamleder
description: Stillingsannonse:   Fair Collection er et spennende og nytenkende selskap innen inkassobransjen i Norge. Vi er kjent for å levere løsninger som sikrer rettferdig behandling av både kunder og oppdragsgivere. Fair består av dyktige fagfolk med fokus på høy kvalitet, effektivitet og gode kundeopplevelser. Vi er et innovativt selskap med et solid omdømme, og hos oss verdsettes trivsel og utvikling på arbeidsplassen.  Vi er nå på jakt etter en dyktig Teamleder for vårt kundesenter inkasso. Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som har erfaring innen inkasso og kundeservice, og som ønsker å bidra til en mer ansvarlig og etisk innkrevingsprosess. Er du ansvarsfull, løsningsorientert, strukturert og god på kommunikasjon – så kan dette være den rette stillingen for deg.   Om arbeidsplassen   Vi holder til i moderne og trivelige lokaler på Løren i Oslo med god kantineordning. Hos oss er vi opptatt av å skape et inkluderende og sosialt arbeidsmiljø der alle skal trives og føle seg verdsatt.   Arbeidsoppgaver:   Teamleder Kundeservice Inkasso er en sentral stilling i virksomheten, og skal sikre god og effektiv leveranse fra de ansatte på Kundeservice Inkasso dag i Fair Collection. Stillingen er delvis operativ og innebærer både personal- og bemanningsansvar, samt kunne bistå inn i den daglige driften. Teamleder inngår som en del av lederteamet på inkasso. Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:    Personalansvar for medarbeiderne i Kundeservice Inkasso, hvor du blant annet vil ha ansvar for å sikre riktig bemanning, medarbeideroppfølging, og rekruttering.  Ansvar for opplæring og kompetanseutvikling.  Følge opp KPI-er, kvalitet og effektivitet.  Optimalisere arbeidsprosesser, ressursfordeling og drift.  Identifisere og gjennomføre forbedrings- og automatiseringstiltak.  Delta aktivt i den operative driften og holde deg tett på den daglige driften. Kvalifikasjoner:     Høyere relevant utdanning innen økonomi, administrasjon, juss eller annen relevant fagretning.  Solid og relevant erfaring fra inkassovirksomhet er en forutsetning for stillingen. Samt erfaring fra leder-, fagansvarlig- eller koordinatorrolle innen inkasso.  God og praktisk anvendbar kunnskap om inkassofaget, herunder gjeldende regelverk, retningslinjer, prosesser og rutiner innen inkasso. Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.  Evne til å motivere og utvikle medarbeidere og skape psykologisk trygghet i teamet.     Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:     Erfaring fra kundesenter.  Utdanning og/eller kurs innen ledelse, coaching eller personaladministrasjon er en fordel.  Tydelig, tilgjengelig og beslutningsdyktig lederstil.  Trives i en hver

title: Manager, Customer Success
description: Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.  We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.   What You'll Shape   As Manager, Customer Success, you'll lead a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for driving retention, customer outcomes, and consistent execution across a growing book of enterprise customers.  You'll serve as the frontline leadership layer between the CSMs and the Director of Enterprise Customer Success EMEA, coaching performance, strengthening customer management discipline, and overseeing risk and escalation handling to keep the team focused on what matters most for customer health and retention.   What You'll Do    Team leadership and people development     Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Managers, setting a high bar for operating discipline across the team.  Drive performance management, including feedback, accountability, coaching plans, and development conversations.  Support hiring, onboarding, and ramping of new team members as the team evolves.  Identify growth opportunities for team members and shape a positive, adaptive culture built on accountability and diverse perspectives.  Run a predictable management cadence, including pipeline and renewal reviews, account reviews, forecasting discussions, and coaching touchpoints.     Customer retention, onboarding, and growth     Ensure the team is proactively managing customer relationships, renewal readiness, adoption risk, and long-term retention.  Oversee the customer onboarding experience, helping the team accelerate time-to-value so customers realize the benefits of the product quickly.  Ensure timely renewals and drive a multi-year renewal strategy as the default, optimizing commercial terms.  Guide CSMs through complex customer situations, including executive conversations, risk mitigation plans, and recovery strategies.  Maintain visibility into high-risk accounts, strategic renewals, and customer trends across the team.     Escalation management     Serve as the initial management layer for customer escalations.  Bring structure, urgency, and sound judgment to escalations, helping CSMs communicate clearly and confidently with customers.     Data-driven management     Maintain daily oversight of key metrics, including forecasting, pipeline, churn, contractions, expansion, forecast accuracy, and team capacity.  Conduct regular deep dives into KPIs to identify gaps in execution, coaching needs, and opportunities

Du kommer att ha stor möjlighet att påverka hur vi utvecklar och framtidssäkrar vår serviceorganisation samtidigt som du säkerställer att vi når våra mål inom kundnöjdhet, kvalitet, effektivitet och lönsamhet. Därför söker vi en ledare som kan skapa engagemang kring förändring och omsätta strategi till konkreta aktiviteter.  Du kommer att arbeta nära både svenska och europeiska kollegor, vilket innebär många kontaktytor och brett samarbete. I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att      Leda, coacha och utveckla chefer och team inom Contract Management, Technical Customer Care och Managed Services. title: Palveluesihenkilöitä pääkaupunkiseudulle
description: Oletko tulosorientoitunut siivousalan osaaja, joka viihtyy vastuullisessa esihenkilötehtävässä? Langat eivät putoa käsistäsi kiireenkään keskellä? Saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö!Etsimme nyt kasvavaan joukkoomme kahta  Palveluesihenkilöä pääkaupunkiseudulle! Siivouksen esihenkilö- ja ohjaustehtävissä tulet vastaamaan asiakaskohteidemme siivouspalveluiden operatiivisesta suunnittelusta ja sujuvuudesta. Hakemamme tekijä on aidosti palveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja viihtyy ajoittain kiireisessäkin työympäristössä organisoiden työnsä tehokkaasti - unohtamatta timanttista ongelmanratkontakykyä!  Tehtävissä menestyminen edellyttää aikaisempaa kokemusta siivousalalta, työnjohdollisista tehtävistä sekä asiakkuuksien tuloksellisesta johtamisesta. Hakemamme henkilön tulee kyetä kommunikoimaan vaivatta niin suomeksi kuin englanniksi ja aidosti viihtyä monikulttuurisessa työympäristössä.Tehtävänkuvan keskiössä ovat myös vahvat vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot sekä kyky toimia itseohjautuvassa esihenkilöroolissa - esimerkillä johtaminen ja alaisten motivoiminen ovat osa päivittäistä tekemistä. Tässä työssä tulet tarvitsemaan ajokorttia, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Myös alan ammattitutkinnosta on sinulle etua.  Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla.RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa osaajilleen kattavan perehdytyksen ja sisäisten koulutus- ja etenemismahdollisuuksien lisäksi täyden tuen ammattitutkintojen suorittamiseen työn ohessa.Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja auttamisen kulttuuria – tukenasi ovat osaavat kollegat ja kannustava esihenkilö.Meille on myös tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi! – vuosittaisessa työvirekyselyssä saimme työntekijäkokemuksesta erinomaisen arvosanan 4,1/5.Työsuhde solmitaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevana ja töiden aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika tehtävissä on kokoaikainen. Palkkaus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan, aiempi kokemus- ja koulutustaustasi huomioiden. Työsuhteessa sovelletaan kiinteistöalan toimihenkilöitä koskevaa työehtosopimusta. Jos koet hyvän työyhteisön olevan sinulle merkityksellinen, viihdyt meillä varmasti!  Lähetä hakemuksesi tai vinkkaa kaverille, toimi kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelut aloitetaan

title: Operations Manager
description: Operations Manager — LYGG    Build the operations of a new regional air mobility concept from the ground up.         LYGG is changing how companies travel across the North Sea. Instead of waiting for airlines to open routes, we build air connections around what businesses actually need, pooling corporate demand from the energy and offshore sector into scheduled flights. Our Esbjerg–Groningen route is already flying, and more of the corridor is on the way with two new routes already announced and starting in October. You'll work directly with the CEO and management team, with a real voice in how the business develops.   Aviation and business in one role.  You'll use your operations expertise and also develop commercial and financial skills, from customer relationships to cost and margin management.   Grow with the company.  As LYGG adds routes and customers, the operations function grows too, and so does your role.   An experienced network around you. What you'll do     Run daily operations  together with our airline operating partners, making sure schedules, ground services and travel arrangements are coordinated and responsibilities are clear.   Own the customer experience.  Be the person our corporate customers can rely on for clear answers and excellent care.   Handle changes and disruptions.  Bring the right people together, weigh the options, make the call, keep customers informed proactively and see every issue through.   Manage partners.  Work day to day with operators, airports, ground handlers and suppliers, and follow up on service and performance.   Keep costs and profitability on track.  Prepare flight and trip cost estimates, compare actuals against budget, verify quotations and invoices, and find ways to improve margins and efficiency.   Keep information accurate  across booking and operational systems and partners.   Build the operating model.  Organise workflows, plan operational and customer-service coverage, and use service and cost data to fix recurring problems for good. title: Lead Business Partner / Head of Client Service
description: The Creative Store    www.thecreativestore.co.nz     Great Jobs. Great People.       This role is with an exceptional Auckland-based agency, a multi-disciplinary creative production studio. With a diverse team of talent from many disciplines, they work locally and globally with clients to create provocative ideas that live within advertising, design, entertainment, and technology.     They are looking for a Lead Business Partner / Head of Client Service to primarily lead one of the agency's most important and exciting clients, as well as drive stability and leadership of an absolutely brilliant team of Client Service talent.     This is a complex, high-profile portfolio account spanning some of New Zealand's best-known alcohol brands. The work is predominantly social-led, meaning this is a role that needs to be equally comfortable in the boardroom, on set and in the detail of a fast-moving content calendar. This isn't simply an account management role. You will be expected to think and operate like a business leader: understanding the business, shaping where you can take the relationship, spotting opportunities, challenging constructively, protecting the quality of the work and making sure every job makes commercial sense.      You will also have an important role as a senior leader within the agency. You will contribute to the vision, culture and growth of the wider agency, helping shape how they work, developing people and supporting the CEO as they continue to evolve. You will own the vision for the client service team, bringing together Strategy, Creative, Social and Production to deliver work that makes a difference for clients and prospects.      Don’t miss this opportunity to work with a globally recognised collaborative team in a forward-thinking, fast-paced and inclusive agency.      If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, apply now.       Due to the volume of applications, we can only reply to candidates who are suitable for our current roles.       Send your CV to  Ginnaya Turner  at The Creative Store, email  Ginnaya@thecreativestore.co.nz , or call The Creative Store on (09) 365 1077 for more details.      Visit The Creative Store website www.thecreativestore.co.nz to view all our jobs online.

title: Customer Success Account Manager
description: Overview   The Customer Success Account Manager (CSAM) is the primary post-sales success lead and trusted advisor for strategic enterprise customers. The purpose of the role is to connect the customer’s digital strategy with Microsoft’s technology capabilities, ensuring that deployed solutions deliver measurable business value, sustained adoption, and continuous evolution of the customer’s digital ecosystem.  The CSAM develops a deep understanding of the customer’s business objectives, technology maturity, operational challenges, and improvement opportunities across cloud, data, security, productivity, and artificial intelligence. From that vantage point, the CSAM anticipates needs, identifies risks, proposes paths to value, and orchestrates Microsoft resources to accelerate the customer’s digital transformation.  This is not a delivery-coordination role. The CSAM acts as a trusted advisor who connects strategic conversations with concrete technical execution.   Responsibilities     Strategic & Operational Customer Relationships — Build and sustain trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, technology teams, and operational stakeholders, moving fluidly between executive conversations and execution-level discussions.  Incident & Escalation Orchestration — Act as the customer’s advocate during critical incidents, coordinating CSS, Engineering, Product Groups, partners, and internal stakeholders to accelerate triage, drive effective communication, identify workarounds, and restore business operations as quickly as possible.  Customer Success Strategy — Lead the definition, refresh, and execution of the Customer Success Plan (CSP), translating business needs into concrete adoption, transformation, and value-generation initiatives.  Cloud & AI Adoption — Actively drive adoption, usage, and expansion of Microsoft cloud and AI solutions — helping customers identify relevant AI use cases, accelerate implementation, promote organizational adoption, and ensure measurable impact.  Delivery & Governance Leadership — Orchestrate the planning, prioritization, tracking, and execution of customer success programs across internal teams, partners, and customer stakeholders.  Risk & Customer Health Management — Monitor customer health; identify technical, operational, commercial, and adoption risks; and lead mitigation plans before issues escalate.  Cross-Functional Orchestration — Mobilize Microsoft resources, technical specialists, partners, and commercial teams toward common outcomes, influencing without direct authority.  Executive Engagement & Business Value — Lead impact- and outcome-focused conversations, communicating progress, risks, opportunities, and recommendations in a clear, executive, decision-oriented manner. title: Salesforce Business Systems Administrator
description:
ROLE: Business Systems Administrator

Location: United States, Remote

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Business Systems Administrators keep the internal systems that run the company secure, reliable, and well-administered. You will own the configuration, access, and health of the business-critical applications our teams depend on every day — making sure they work, stay secure, and scale with the business.

This is a hands-on systems and administration role with real ownership. You will administer core business applications, manage access and permissions with a security-first mindset, and build the automation and process that keep those systems reliable. Working within our Security organization, you will treat access and configuration as security controls, not just IT tasks.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Administer and configure core business systems and SaaS applications, keeping them reliable, secure, and well-governed.
  • Manage user access, roles, and permissions with a security-first approach — enforcing least privilege and clean provisioning and deprovisioning.
  • Automate administration, access reviews, and routine tasks to reduce manual effort and error.
  • Integrate business systems and maintain the data flows between them.
  • Partner with Security, IT, and business teams to support audits, access reviews, and compliance requirements.
  • Document configurations and build repeatable processes that keep systems maintainable as the company grows.

This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: About Ascend   At Ascend, we provide software to nonprofits and foundations to help them fundraise through innovative lottery programs. Our clients include hospitals, branded non profits, humane societies, and others across North America. Ascend has raised more than $1.4B for non profit organizations to date.  We’re growing fast, and our Customer Success Managers are at the center of that growth. At Ascend, you’ll learn how to be a world-class Customer Success Manager — how to grow revenue, influence executives, and drive lasting impact.      The Role    At Ascend, Customer Success is a revenue engine. You’ll own a portfolio of clients and your job is to grow their lottery revenue — which grows ours. That means influencing, persuading, and guiding clients to make moves that drive results.    You’ll be measured on the growth of your accounts. To win here, you need to be revenue minded, intelligent, and relentless in creating opportunities.       What You’ll Be Doing    Owning client relationships end-to-end: being the trusted partner who knows their goals, challenges, and opportunities for growth.  Thinking like an owner: spot growth levers in each account and act on them. We’ll teach you how to do it.  Creating strategies and plans to convince clients to invest more in lottery prizes, emails and marketing to drive revenue.  Upselling clients to run more programming based on our products — payroll raffles, 50/50s, prize raffles, marketing add-ons.  Running tight follow-ups, keeping opportunities moving even when faced with slow moving deals.       What We’re Looking For    You’ve carried a number before: in sales development, sales, or revenue-focused CSM roles.  You know how to influence decision makers and make the ROI case stick.  You’re persistent — you follow up until it gets done.  You think like an owner: you can quickly connect the dots between strategy and revenue.  You like building relationships, but you also know relationships are built on results.       Why Join Us    Attractive base salary and variable comp package tied directly to the revenue you grow — your upside is in your hands.  High-impact work: you’ll be the difference between a client raising thousands vs. millions.  A team that moves fast, thinks like owners, and cares about the mission.  The chance to build your career in a startup-like environment with the stability of a market leader.  A true career accelerator: at Ascend, you’ll learn how to be a world-class Customer Success Manager — how to grow revenue, influence executives, and drive lasting impact.  Mission with meaning: most of our clients are hospital foundations. When you help them grow, you’re helping strengthen Canada’s public healthcare system and ensuring better care for all of our families across the country.  Hybrid work environment: Three days a week in our beautiful office in Toronto’s Financial District.

title: Manager Klanttevredenheid (CEM) Venlo
description: Wat ga je doen?  Maak elke klantbeleving onvergetelijk. Let's Go!  Als  Manager Klanttevredenheid (CEM)  bij MediaMarkt ben jij de drijvende kracht achter een uitstekende klantbeleving. Jij zorgt ervoor dat klanten met een glimlach de winkel verlaten én dat collega's iedere dag met plezier het beste uit zichzelf halen. Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer, inspireert je team en weet precies hoe je service naar een hoger niveau tilt.  Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je start de dag met een energieke teambriefing, waarin jullie successen vieren en de focus voor de dag bepalen. Vervolgens ben je aanwezig op de winkelvloer, waar je klanten helpt, collega's coacht en direct inspeelt op kansen om de klantreis nóg beter te maken. Je analyseert klantfeedback, bespreekt verbeterpunten met het management en neemt het initiatief om processen en service continu te verbeteren. Dankzij jouw enthousiasme, leiderschap en klantgerichte mindset voelt iedere klant én collega zich welkom en gehoord.   Dit Ga Je Doen     Je zet alles op alles om de klanttevredenheid te overtreffen en creëert iedere dag een optimale klantbeleving.  Je herkent de behoeften van klanten en zorgt ervoor dat zij met de juiste oplossing én een glimlach de winkel verlaten.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte afhandeling van de geld- en goederenstromen binnen de vestiging.  Je ondersteunt klanten bij customer care, aftersales, online bestellingen, Click & Collect, reparaties en servicevragen.  Je coacht en motiveert collega's op de werkvloer en draagt actief bij aan een positieve, energieke werksfeer.  Je signaleert verbeterkansen en vertaalt klantfeedback naar concrete acties om de dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.    Wie ben jij?    Een echte teamspeler;  Een inspirerende, motiverende en coachende leider;  Je bent een talent op gebied van de klanttevredenheid en hospitality en deze passie deel je graag met onze medewerkers;  Je helpt samen met jouw collega’s de nodige (commerciële) organisatiedoelstellingen te behalen;  Je bent besluitvaardig, prestatiegericht en gedreven;   Jouw focus ligt op het behalen van optimale en maximale klanttevredenheid;  Je bent 38 uur per week beschikbaar, waarvan minstens een avond en een dag in het weekend.    Over ons  Ready for the big picture? Let’s Go!  Wij zijn de nummer één in de BeNeLux en in Europa. We beïnvloeden hoe mensen technologie ervaren en gebruiken. Wij maken het verschil. We zijn er voor onze klanten, via alle kanalen. We leggen uit, inspireren en enthousiasmeren. We zijn altijd in beweging. Samen met onze fantastische medewerkers creëren we de winkelervaring van de toekomst.   Additional Benefits   Bij MediaMarkt kan je echt jezelf zijn. Daarnaast:    Bieden wij jou een baan waarin je veel verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en zelf met ideeën komt;   Bieden wij jou de mogelijkheid op het verdienen van een aantrekkelijke maandelijkse bonus;  Bieden wij jou uitzicht op een vaste baan;  Een baan bij MediaMarkt is veelzijdig en afwiss

title: Corporate & SPV KYC Team Lead
description: A leading international banking group is establishing a new Dublin-based KYC onboarding team and is seeking an experienced KYC professional to help build and lead the function.  This is a hands-on team leadership position with two direct reports initially and scope for the team to grow. You will oversee the end-to-end onboarding of institutional clients, complex corporate structures and special purpose vehicles, while acting as a key contact for clients and senior stakeholders across the business. description: Har du erfaring med personaleledelse og kan du motivere og engagere dygtige medarbejdere? Har du blik for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og effektiv administration? Som vores nye leder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse og udvikling af et team af 25 kunderådgivere, der vejleder borgere og behandler sager inden for pensionsområdet.     Du videreudvikler teamet og sørger for en effektiv og driftssikker sagsbehandling, som medvirker til, at teamet når de mål, der er sat.     Du optimerer den daglige drift gennem læring, tavlestyring og via din interesse for at anvende ny teknologi i driften. Du har et helheds- og udviklingsorienteret perspektiv på opgaverne, så du sammen med dine kolleger og ledelse i de øvrige sektioner lykkes med den samlede opgave.     Se Kristian, en af dine kommende lederkolleger, fortælle om jobbet som leder i ATP.      Hvem er du?   Du har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund og solid erfaring med personaleledelse fra eksempelvis en kundeservicefunktion kombineret med sagsbehandling.      Du har forudsætningerne for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser for de borgere, vi er i kontakt med, og så er det vigtigt, at du kan bidrage til en effektiv administration.      I rollen som personaleleder er du nærværende og motiverende. Du skaber en positiv holdånd i teamet og samarbejder på tværs af organisationen.      Derudover er du den rigtige til jobbet, hvis du:      sætter prioriterede mål for dine medarbejdere og skaber sammenhæng mellem mål og strategi  sikrer åbenhed og godt samarbejde  kommunikerer mening og retning klart og tydeligt  har en reflekterende og procesorienteret tilgang til opgaveløsningen  er nysgerrig på at tilegne dig fagligheden til at kunne forstå processerne på dit fagområde, så du også kan være med til at optimere og udvikle dem.        Hvem er vi?      I ATP går vi på arbejde for den enkelte og samfundet. Du får et job med stor betydning for de mange borgere, der modtager ydelser fra ATP, herunder de 1,5 mio. pensionister, der hver måned får udbetalt deres pensioner korrekt og til tiden. Med ansvaret følger et meningsfuldt arbejdsliv, og det er vi stolte af at kunne tilbyde.      I Holstebro er vi omkring 225 medarbejdere, hvoraf størstedelen beskæftiger sig med sagsbehandling på pensionsområdet.      Du bliver en del af en stor organisation i en spændende forandring. Vi er i gang med en omskolingsproces, som forsætter de næste år, hvor flere både skal afgive og modtage nye opgaver. Her kommer du som leder sammen med sektionen til at have en vigtig rolle.     Du bliver en del af en ledergruppe på tværs af boligstøtte- og pensionsområdet fordelt på vores lokationer i Holstebro og Frederikshavn.      Vi er engagerede, drifts- og løsningsorienterede og optagede af hele tiden at udvikle os. Vi har et tæt samarbejde på tværs og en uformel omgangstone, hvor videndeling, sparring og læring fylder meget.      Og så lægger vi vægt på, at det også skal være sjovt

title: Teamleder/ kontoransvarlig
description: Varig Forsikring Møre og Romsdal og Varig Orkla Forsikring slås i disse dager sammen til Varig Forsikring Midt-Norge. Sammen bygger vi et sterkere, lokalt forankret forsikringsmiljø – eid av kundene og med nærhet til menneskene, bedriftene og lokalsamfunnene vi er en del av.     Historien vår strekker seg tilbake til 1841 og bygger på fellesskap, gjensidighet og trygghet. Med lokal kunnskap og personlig rådgivning skal vi også fremover være en trygg samarbeidspartner for kundene våre.  Gjennom Varigfondet gir vi tilbake til lokalsamfunnet og støtter lokal idrett, kultur og frivillighet. Slik bidrar vi til levende lokalsamfunn og skaper verdier som kommer fellesskapet til gode.  Vi er eier i og samarbeidspartner med både Frende Forsikring og Brage Finans. Det gjør at vi kan kombinere lokal tilstedeværelse med sterke fagmiljøer og et bredt tilbud innen forsikring og finansiering.      Er du vår nye teamleder for kontoret i Kristiansund?         Vil du være med på å skape gode salgsresultater, sterke kunderelasjoner og et godt arbeidsmiljø? Vi søker en engasjert og operativ teamleder/kontoransvarlig til kontoret vårt i Kristiansund.     En operativ lederrolle tett på mennesker og kunder  Ved kontoret i Kristiansund er vi sju medarbeidere – seks innen privatmarked og én innen næringsliv. Som teamleder/kontoransvarlig skaper du struktur i hverdagen og bidrar til at teamet lykkes sammen. Rollen er utpreget operativ. Du har eget salgsbudsjett og jobber aktivt med kunderådgivning og salg.  Dine viktigste oppgaver;   Daglig drift og teamoppfølging    Koordinere den daglige driften og bidra til gode rutiner, tydelige prioriteringer og god samhandling på kontoret.  Være kontorets lokale støtte i gjennomføringen av salgsaktiviteter, kampanjer og andre prioriterte tiltak.  Legge til rette for samarbeid mellom privatmarked og næringsliv, i tett dialog med de respektive lederne.       Salg og kunderådgivning    Jobbe mot eget salgsbudsjett gjennom aktiv kunderådgivning, salg og oppfølging av nye og eksisterende kunder.  Kartlegge kundenes behov og tilby relevante forsikringsløsninger.  Gå foran som et godt eksempel innen kundeopplevelse, kvalitet og salgsarbeid.    Lokal synlighet og engasjement    Representere selskapet i lokale nettverk og møteplasser.  Bygge relasjoner til lokalt næringsliv, organisasjoner og samarbeidspartnere.  Følge opp lokale sponsoravtaler og aktiviteter knyttet til Varigfondet, i tråd med selskapets rammer og prioriteringer.  Samarbeide med markedsavdelingen om aktiviteter som styrker vår synlighet og tilstedeværelse i Kristiansund og nærområdet.      Hvem ser vi etter?  Vi ser etter deg som trives med å skape resultater sammen med andre, samtidig som du motiveres av eget salg og gode kundemøter. Du tar initiativ, skaper tillit og evner å få med deg kollegaene dine – uten å ha formelt personalansvar.     Vi tror du har:   Erfaring med salg og kunderådgivning, gjerne fra forsikring, bank eller annen relevant tjenesteyting.  Erfaring

title: Palvelupäällikkö, Huoneistohallinnointipalvelut
description: Mikä homma?      Tässä roolissa pääset kasvattamaan huoneistohallintopalveluidemme liiketoimintaa erinomaiselta pohjalta huippukollegoiden kanssa. Huoneistohallinnointipalvelumme piirissä on jo reilut 600 asuntoa ja tiimiisi kuuluu 3 hallinnoinnin ammattilaista.     Tavoitteemme on nousta lähivuosina yhdeksi pääkaupunkiseudun merkittävimmistä huoneistohallinnoinnin toimijoista. Etsimme nyt päällikköä, joka ottaa vetovastuun tämän kasvun toteuttamisesta.     Kyseessä on kasvurooli: vastaat uusasiakashankinnasta, liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä ja tiimin johtamisesta. Onnistumisesi näkyy uusina asiakkuuksina, kasvavana asuntojen määränä ja liiketoiminnan kasvuna. Tukenasi ovat Roofin yli 150 hengen organisaatio sekä esihenkilösi, kaupallinen johtaja Roni.      Meistä      Roof perustettiin vuonna 2017 uudistamaan kiinteistönvälitystä inhimillisemmällä, rehdimmällä ja modernimmalla palvelulla. Tänään Roofilla työskentelee jo yli 130 välittäjää ja kiinteistöalan ammattilaista ympäri Suomen. Olemme nousseet nopeasti yhdeksi alan kiinnostavimmista kasvuyrityksistä ja matka jatkuu edelleen. Tervetuloa mukaan Roofin tarinaan!      Vastuualueet      Päätehtävä: B2B-asiakashankinta ja liiketoiminnan kasvu   Ensimmäisen vuoden tärkein tavoitteesi on kasvattaa hallinnoitavien asuntojen määrää hankkimalla uusia asiakkaita (sijoittajat, säätiöt ja yritykset).  Vastaat koko myyntiprosessista ensimmäisestä tapaamisesta sopimuksen allekirjoittamiseen.  Rakennat aktiivisesti verkostoasi ja edustat Roofia alan tapahtumissa.  Tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeet ja ohjaat heitä myös Roofin muihin palveluihin.   Toissijainen tehtävä: Tiimin johtaminen ja yksikön kehittäminen   Johdat kolmen hengen tiimin arkea ja kehität toimintaa.  Vastaat yksikön budjetista ja raportoit kaupalliselle johtajalle.  Osallistut tiimin kasvattamiseen ja rekrytointeihin.       Tarjoamme sinulle       Mahdollisuuden kasvattaa omaa liiketoimintayksikköäsi nopeasti kasvavassa yrityksessä.  Aidon mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa liiketoiminnan suuntaan ja kasvuun.  Vahvan brändin, valmiin asiakaskunnan ja 150+ hengen organisaation tuen.  Kannustavan palkkamallin ilman provisiokattoa.  Modernit työvälineet ja joustavat työskentelytavat.       Menestyäksesi tässä roolissa, sinulla on:       Näyttöä tuloksellisesta B2B-myynnistä  Itsenäinen ja tavoitteellinen tapa rakentaa myyntiputkea.  Kyky johtaa pientä tiimiä ja saada ihmiset onnistumaan.  Erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot sekä sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito.   Erityisesti arvostamme:   Kokemusta asuntosijoittamisesta tai kiinteistöhallinnoinnista.  Olemassa olevaa verkostoa sijoittaja- tai säätiömaailmassa.  Aiempaa esihenkilökokemusta.  Monikielisyyttä, etenkin ruotsin kielen taitoa.       Palkkaus ja rekrytointiprosessi      Pohjapalkka 3000€/kk + suoriutumisperusteinen osa. Odotettava kuukausipalkka tavoitetasolla on  4500–5 000 €/kk - ei provisiokattoa!  Tämän lisäksi on mahdollisuus vuosittaiseen onnistumisbonukseen.     Haethan viimeistään

title: Data Engineer / Scientist – Multimodal Clinical Data Integration & AI (m/f/d)
description:
About aiPTO

aiPTO is a TechBio startup spun off from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ), taking on one of medicine's hardest problems: brain cancer. We are building a disruptive approach — pairing next-generation patient-derived living tumor with fit-for-purpose virtual-tumor AI models. By recreating a patient's tumor biology in vitro and decoding it in silico, we aim to revolutionize brain cancer drug discovery and precision medicine. More details can be found on our publications (Individualized patient tumor organoids faithfully preserve human brain tumor ecosystems and predict patient response to therapy, DELPHAI predicts heterogeneous perturbation responses with learned single-cell fitness) and LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/aipto/).

The project

aiPTO has been selected as the data and AI partner of a newly funded Horizon Europe consortium that unites world-class neuro-oncologists, pathologists and drug-discovery pioneers across Europe. Together we are generating patient profiles of unprecedented depth: multi-omics, high-resolution digital pathology, 3D imaging and longitudinal clinical records, alongside single-cell drug-perturbation data from patient-derived organoids.

As the first member of our Heidelberg hub, you will build the data engine that turns these massive, disparate streams into AI-ready data atlas — the foundation for virtual tumor models and agentic systems designed to predict patient-specific drug response, decode resistance and reveal drug mechanisms.

What you will do

  • Architect the scientific data engine: design, build and scale the infrastructure that unifies multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, digital pathology, radiological imaging and clinical data

  • Make data AI-ready: harmonise and standardise multimodal datasets for deep-learning models and agentic workflows, working hand-in-hand with our machine-learning and computer-vision scientists

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

 

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

 

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

 

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

 

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

 

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Unsere Spiele sind mehr als nur Code – sie sind dynamische Welten, die Du durch Dein Auge fürs Detail aktiv mitgestaltest. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Spieler täglich in fesselnde und fehlerfreie Abenteuer eintauchen können. Ob bei riesigen MMOs oder unserer innovativen Zahlungssoftware – bei uns hakst Du keine Listen ab, sondern sicherst mit Deinen eigenen kreativen Testfällen die höchsten Qualitätsstandards in unseren Produkten.

Bist Du bereit, Deine Leidenschaft für Games und Dein Gespür fürs Detail einzubringen, um das Spielerlebnis auf das nächste Level zu bringen? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt an unserem Sitz in Regensburg und gestalte die Zukunft unserer Online-Welten mit.

Bei uns kannst Du:

  • Deine Kreativität im Testing ausleben und eigene Testpläne und -fälle erstellen, um unsere Welten auf Herz und Nieren zu prüfen

  • zusammen mit Deinen Kollegen Monster, NPCs, Quests und Kampfsysteme manuell testen und dadurch kontinuierlich verbessern

  • ein Teil von abwechslungsreichen und spannenden Projekten sein und durch den Austausch mit anderen Teams tief in die Spieleentwicklung eintauchen

  • Tests mit Spielern planen, koordinieren und überwachen, um das bestmögliche Spielerlebnis sicherzustellen

  • Testumgebungen aufsetzen und pflegen, sowie Dein Talent fürs Skripten

title: Senior Project Manager Digital Plattform Automotive (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.

Ce poste a vocation à assurer la continuité de service sur les portefeuilles temporairement sans gestionnaire titulaire (remplacement, vacance de poste, surcroît d'activité, transition entre deux gestionnaires). title: PhD - Inverse modal identification of free-field radiated noise from unducted rotor-stator stages: from laboratory arrays to Open Fan flight tests
description:
Context:

This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources.

Objective:

To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size).

Description:

Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.
